Join forces with other players to speed through intense arcade races, perform jaw-dropping stunts, and charge towards victory while driving the finest hypercars! Take On the World Gear up and dive into the international arena of Asphalt Legends' online multiplayer mode. Challenge up to 7 opponents from every corner of the world across platforms in thrilling cross-play races. Engage in split-screen competitions with friends (up to 4 players). Get ready to group together, dominate, and leave your mark on the asphalt! Join Global Racing Legends Embrace the global racing community where camaraderie fuels the pursuit of victory. Connect with friends through the friend list, create private lobbies for personalized races and rally with Asphalt titans! Join or establish racing Clubs, unlocking exclusive rewards as you climb the leaderboards. Experience a new cooperative multiplayer mode where you can be a Security agent chasing down Syndicate members or one of the outlaws evading capture. Pick Your Ride and Dominate the Competition Harness the power of the pack: Over 250 hypercars await, from elite manufacturers such as Ferrari, Porsche and Lamborghini, each meticulously crafted to push the boundaries of speed and performance. Conquer tracks inspired by iconic locations across the world, cherished by racers worldwide. Feel the Rush of Absolute Control Feel one with the beat of the track as you and your teammates dive into electrifying races, perform gravity-defying stunts, and power to victory with adrenaline-fueled boosts. With precise manual control or streamlined TouchDrive™, Asphalt Legends puts you in the driver's seat, ready to steal the show! Arcade Racing at Its Finest Dive into the thrilling world of high-speed racing, where detailed vehicles, stunning effects, and vibrant dynamic lighting await. Kick-Start Your Racing Legacy Take the wheel on your journey to racing greatness in Career mode. Maneuver through endless seasons and conquer diverse challenges at every turn. Feel the thrill of pulse-pounding events, with a constant stream of limited-time challenges and activities to keep you on the edge of your seat. This is your chance to carve out a legacy that echoes throughout the racetrack! Customize Your Ride, Own the Road Personalize your vehicle and show off your style to your rivals with unique body paint, rims, wheels, and body parts!
row.short_description: Spark your competitive soul with Asphalt Legends and feel the collective heartbeat of the road! Join forces with other players to speed through intense arcade races, perform jaw-dropping stunts, and charge towards victory while driving the finest hypercars!

row.name: Meteor Volleyball!
row.detailed_description: Meteor Volleyball! is a simple, fun, comic-like volleyball game that simulates your life if there were a meteor heading towards Earth and you have to survive by piloting a volleyball robot. Comic-like cut scene and fun dialogue. 2D platform volleyball game. Very simple control. Various Special Skills. Story The earth is in danger of being destroyed by a huge meteorite! Thanks to a genius Doctor, we can deflect meteorites! But then... Oh my gosh! This time, countless meteorites are falling! If a meteor lands, your house will be destroyed! Pilot the robot to protect our house!
row.short_description: Meteor Volleyball! is a simple, fun, comic-like volleyball game that simulates your life if there were a meteor heading towards Earth and you have to survive by piloting a volleyball robot. Protect your home and survive!

row.name: VR Tablet PC
row.detailed_description: Attention : VR Tablet PC supports keyboard input in English, Japanese and Korean. What are you using a VR device for? Just for fun? entertainment? Suppose you need to add a handwritten signature to an electronic document on a PC or add a drawing by hand, and you only have a desktop PC and a mouse. Besides, you don't have a tablet PC, pen type digitizer, camera, or scanner. If so, do you have to buy them additionally? If you have a VR device, you don't have to. You can use this app to perform the above actions in VR space. Any PC-based app can be used in VR space, so you can draw or write with any app you want. And, edit it with another app. And, attach an image, that has been edited, to another app to use. All of the above tasks can be batch-processed in VR space using VR Tablet PC. If so, wouldn't that be a sufficient reason to use the VR device as a necessity? If the work area cannot be seen well on the screen due to the limitation of resolution, touch input work can be performed by enlarging only this part separately. For Oculus users, it is recommended to use 'Touch Controller of Oculus Rift S' if possible.
row.short_description: This VR Tablet PC is a kind of virtual PC in VR space. VR users can use this VR Tablet PC to perform touch input , dragging input on the display of a virtual PC, or input letters with virtual stylus pens and virtual keyboard, just like using a tablet PC in a real environment.

row.name: Tape Recovery Simulator 96K DEMO
row.detailed_description: Tape Recovery Simulator 96K is a game about recovering data off of reluctant old tapes. Rediscover the lost art of loading data off tapes. Explore and reclaim hidden digital treasures or ignore worthless data. Fight a single undefeatable boss and his management nonsense. Features: Enjoy using a real simulated tape player with all the proper buttons (play, stop, ff, rew). Turbo tape loading speed speed of up to 1.6 kb/s. 8bit applications. Tutorials available for players without previous experience on loading data off tapes. Skippable tutorials for advanced players. Discover and enjoy Goatsketcher's fake art. Work and suffer for a pittance as an EES employee with an absurd boss and (semi-)impossible tasks. Tweak sound volume to appease the 8bit loading routine that is extremly unforgiving to data errors. Rediscover and use old data recoverty tricks. Absolutely no cutscenes. Dad time supported. Can be played for as little as a few minutes at a time.
row.short_description: Tape Recovery Simulator 96K is a game about recovering data off of reluctant old tapes. Rediscover the lost art of loading data off tapes. Fix errors. Explore and reclaim hidden digital treasures. Receive emails. Fight a single undefeatable boss and his management nonsense. Rewind and try again.
row.reviews: “In Tape Recovery Simulator 96K, you’ll work for a firm specializing in recovering data from cassette tapes.” INTO INDIE GAMES “TRS96K Is a Wonderous Niche Indie Title About Data Recovery on Tapes” 3bit “Soon, You Can Fulfill You Dream Of Becoming A Tape Recovery Specialist With This Upcoming Simulation Video Game” MIKESHOUTS

row.name: EXIT 2
row.detailed_description: EXIT 2 is a free multiplayer horror game in which a team of players must collect and deliver keys and then escape, while another player must stop them as a monster. How it works? There are 2 teams, the Survivor and the Monster. The survivors must collect keys scattered around the map and then deliver them to their respective key stations, once done they must then escape. However, 1 player plays the monster that prevents the survivor from escaping and sabotages them. Perks Both as a survivor and as a monster, you can choose from a variety of perks that you can use to customize your playstyle. Customization You can choose from a variety of skins and voicelines to customize your character.
row.short_description: EXIT 2 is a free multiplayer horror game in which a team of players must collect and deliver keys and then escape, while another player must stop them as a monster.

row.name: Efir Adventure: Matchcraft
row.detailed_description: Try yourself as a master making equipment for flying ethereal ships. And then test the ships you've created in battle! PLAY AND COLLECT - directly participate in the process of making ships! Collect useful materials and create powerful items. The power of items will depend on your skill! FIGHT AND WIN - assemble a warship from the items you have made and set off on a dangerous journey through the expanses of the Lumenarium universe. DEVELOP BLUEPRINTS - Each blueprint for crafting an item can be improved and modified to suit your purposes. EXPAND your island - Build and upgrade buildings to expand and enhance your item building capabilities. EQUIP EXPEDITIONS - from time to time you will get the opportunity to equip expeditions to the far corners of the universe and receive a decent reward. The more generously and wisely you equip the expedition, the more worthy the reward will await you! ADAPT to change and use changing global conditions to your advantage, whether it's a lucky trade offer or a meteor storm!
row.short_description: Efir Adventure: Matchcraft, a unique hybrid crafting and combat simulator based on match3 mechanics with elements of a fantasy space adventure.

row.name: Ghostwire: Tokyo - Prelude
row.detailed_description: Experience the mysterious events leading into Tango Gameworks’ highly anticipated action-adventure game, Ghostwire: Tokyo! In Ghostwire: Tokyo – Prelude, join the mysterious KK and his gang of supernatural detectives as they investigate an unusual disappearance, only to stumble upon something even more sinister. Build relationships with your team and piece together their stories in this visual novel adventure before taking to the streets of Ghostwire: Tokyo, releasing March 25.
row.short_description: Join KK and his gang of supernatural detectives as they investigate a strange disappearance, only to stumble upon something more sinister. Build relationships with your team and piece together their stories.

row.name: XO Evolved
row.detailed_description: XO Evolved is an 'evolution' of Tic-Tac-Toe! It takes the strategic, basic three-in-a-row game and propels it to an all-new board game of full strategy and options. Taking inspiration from both the classic Tic-Tac-Toe game and the collectable card game genre, XO Evolved elevates Tic-Tac-Toe into a more complex and strategy based board game while also retaining that simple, classic feel. To win in XO Evolved, it won't just be a 'three in a row' to finish the game. Players will fight head-to-head utilizing special card effects to gain an edge on the board. Mirrors and lasers will occupy the board to be manipulated by each player to reach victory. To win, you won't just be using your cards and flipping mirrors to be the first to match three shapes in a row. XO Evolved requires the players to match as many of their shapes in a 'three in a row' to have the highest number of sets when the board is full. Along with cards, lasers, and mirrors, XO Evolved offers customization to players to make the game truly their own. XO Evolved supports any way of play, allowing players to change the time limit of a match, the board, the cards used, and more! FEATURES: - Local 2 player head to head - Remote Multiplayer with chat - Game piece cosmetics - Wide variety of card abilities to fit your play style - Control of match settings - CPU opponent - Collect all the cards!
row.short_description: XO evolved is a revolutionary new twist to the game of tic tac toe. XO Evolved is a much more complex and strategic version of tic tac toe, featuring more shapes, exciting mechanics such as lasers, and cards with special effects to turn the tide of the game.

row.name: SurvivalIsLand
row.detailed_description: Discord： This is an open survival game. You can collect, build, explore, and survive. We are randomly sent to a certain location on the desert island, collect and build our own base, find materials for making food, prevent ourselves from starving to death, find materials for making weapons, and protect the base and our own lives. There will be PVP battles between players, and monsters will be fought, it is best to survive the battle or you will lose everything in your backpack and in your hands. Players need to constantly collect materials to build their own houses, and build totems to prevent other players from building. Items can be forged through the furnace, including weapons for legitimate defense. Players can also learn magic skills to fight back against other players or monsters more effectively. Of course, there are many other gameplays, and we will add more gameplay mechanisms in the future, such as fighting with BOSS, iterating more advanced combat systems, and so on. Hope to enter the game experience, after all, this is an open survival game.
row.short_description: 'Survival Island' is a open sandbox survival game. We will be born on a barren island, and there will be many rare and exotic animals on this island. By collecting, building, manufacturing, and fighting his survivors, we will finally survive on this deserted island.

row.name: TechnoMagic
row.detailed_description: Technomagic is a free MMORPG game that based on Match-3 mechanics. Simply put, you fight by moving stones on the field, but you have almost everything you can get from an MMORPG: battles with other players, a large selection of equipment, ranks, clans, professions, and trading. There are no level 80 elves here. There are no elves here at all. Players are divided into two feuding factions: humans and dwarves. If the humans are waiting almost classic fantasy, the game for the dwarves is much closer to steampunk. Humans have powerful magic and formidable elements. Dwarves improve their technology and deadly mechanisms. According the plot, many years ago the world of Elinor was home to an advanced civilization, but now only ruins and crowds of monsters of unknown origin remain of the former luxury. Depending on your choice, the world will happily open its arms to a glorified warrior, a collector of rare valuables, a successful merchant, a monster slayer, a traveler and an explorer. It's up to you to decide what you will become and what path you will choose.
row.short_description: Technomagic is a free browser MMO RPG game. The battle system is based on the rules of logic. Every fight victory depends not only on luck, armor or weapons, but also on the power of your thoughts.

row.name: Return Alive
row.detailed_description: As the survivor in a world ravaged by the black fog, the player must compete against other survivors to claim scarce resources, technology, and energy out in the wilderness. Players will be able to face off greater, better players by building their own mastery through battlegrounds where players face multiple enemies or through matches where players team up to compete against other teams. Stylish Combat There is a wide variety of weapons in the arsenal. Players will be able to acquire various weapons through missions and devise their own style to compete against other players. Players can equip up to 2 weapons, allowing them to pick and choose to maximize the synergy between the weapons. Various Modes Players can play in battlegrounds, matches, and other various modes. Each mode has a different goal for victory. Players must devise their own strategy to win in each mode. Return Alive currently offers 4 battlegrounds and 4 matches. More modes and maps will be developed in the future. Gameplay and Growth Players can collect various weapons to participate in stylish combat and enhance weapon stats through item acquisition. Players can collect Battlesuit to change their appearances and raise the levels to unlock various functions. Players can also select their own skill effects through growth. Character growth and various equipment, and combinations will motivate players to continue with the gameplay. Matchmaking will allow players to go against other players of similar strata or those that are slightly above in terms of skill level. Press towards higher grounds through character growth and tactical combinations!
row.short_description: Return Alive is a Free-to-Play Top-down Shooter Game.

row.name: Pinecone Game
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Pinecone Game, where you can plunge into the wonderful world of throwing pinecones into a well! Throw pinecones into the well - just pick up a pinecone and throw it into the well in the middle of your flying island. The new pine cone will be available in 24 hours. Take a look at the leaderboard - find out how many pinecones your friends and other players from all over the world have thrown into the well. Sit down and rest - while waiting for a new pinecone, you can sit on a specially equipped bench and relax, contemplating the surrounding nature. WARNING! For your safety, do not climb over the fences of the flying island, or hang over the walls of the well.
row.short_description: Welcome to Pinecone Game, where you can plunge into the wonderful world of throwing pinecones into a well!

row.name: The RPG Engine
row.detailed_description: Immerse Yourself in the Ultimate Digital TTRPG Experience! The RPG Engine is your all-in-one toolkit for creating and experiencing dynamic roleplaying worlds. Whether you're a seasoned Game Master or a newcomer, our powerful engine transforms your tabletop adventures into interactive 3D experiences. As a Game Master, tap into your creativity with an intuitive world-building interface. Design and manage immersive 3D maps, complete with: Build new custom maps and form them into campaigns.  Terrain Sculpting: Mold the landscape, including overhangs and caves, and paint the terrain. Interactive Props: Populate your world with items for players to discover. Character Creation: Develop custom characters with various skin tones, hair, features, and clothing.  Dynamic Control: Equip and unequip weapons and items, and import images as flat maps, signs, or standee characters. Add premade or construct kitbashed weapons, items, and gear to your world.  Custom Servers: If you know someone with the Builders or GameMasters DLC; host a server that they can join. Dive into unique, hand-crafted 3D worlds with your friends. Experience rich gameplay features, including: Exploration: Navigate through custom-built environments. Character Control: Animate and control your characters seamlessly. Assign standardized and custom characters to your players, enhancing their agency as you see fit. Combat Visualization: Engage in thrilling combat scenarios. Real-Time Communication: Chat with fellow players to enhance storytelling. Special Effects: Enhance your narrative with stunning visual effects. Need fast access to an item or a fully built world? Simply download from the Steam Workshop and have it in seconds. Assets created in game can be shared with others- this includes maps, characters, special items, and player sheets. We believe in sharing and growing our creations as a community, as such, workshop sharing will always remain free. Beyond TTRPGs The RPG Engine's versatile interface is perfect for various creative applications, such as: Brainstorming Sessions Storyboarding Projects Visual Storytelling Level Design Prototyping Join us in revolutionizing tabletop roleplaying. With The RPG Engine, your imagination is the only limit! Ready to Craft Your Adventure? Download The RPG Engine today and start building your own interactive worlds! This is the base version of the game, if you wish to unlock all features, consider the Builders Edition DLC. Want to host all of your friends?... Check out the GameMasters Edition. Need More? The base version provides an introduction to The RPG Engine and is more than sufficient for people joining other games or those who want to try out the game. Builders Edition DLC gives you more tools, workshop sharing, many more assets, and the ability to bring one Base player into the party pool. GameMasters Edition makes you the ultimate GM with endless seats for Base players (they join free!).
row.short_description: Host immersive tabletop campaigns in a world imagined entirely by you! Build from the ground up with The RPG Engine, an intuitive virtual tabletop that lets you create unparalleled roleplaying environments for your party to get lost in.

row.name: Ancient Wars: Sparta Definitive Edition Playtest
STALCRAFT: X
row.detailed_description: STALCRAFT: X is an exciting online MMOFPS game with Survival Horror elements. It combines open world, RPG and dynamic shooter. For more than 10 years, our team has been creating a unique living world of Chernobyl Exclusion Zone, that will give you new emotions and impressions. GAMEPLAY DESCRIPTION Dive into the world through an atypical for MMO cinematic non-linear storyline, which creates the feeling of passing single-player game in the stalker setting for dozens of hours. In the Zone, your choices always matter, and you'll be able to try on any role and find an activity to your taste: hunting for artefacts or players with artefacts, exploring territories and caches, trading, science, banditry, faction wars and a huge variety of other PvP and PvE activities. You'll also have your own hideout for resting and preparing for new raids, which you can equip with various furniture and useful structures for crafting. LIVING OPEN WORLD The world of STALCRAFT: X will truly surprise you. In addition to real players creating unique situations for each other, it is filled with NPCs and mutants living their normal lives, as well as factions fighting and trading with each other. The zone is not only dangerous, but also a very beautiful place — various anomalies affect the view of the area and add a special charm to the post-apocalyptic world. At all locations you can be shot by players from another faction, but you will not lose your equipment and progress, but will lose most of the resources you've gained during your trip. Thanks to this, you will keep the thrill of each raid, and failures will not be fatal. UNIQUE COMBINATION OF FPS AND RPG GENRES The balance of weapons is not typical for open-world MMOs and is rather reminiscent of session shooters like Counter Strike and Call of Duty. We characterise the shooter component as fast-paced, tied primarily to shooting skills and terrain knowledge. Over the years, we have managed to combine FPS and RPG elements in a unique combination, which makes STALCRAFT: X special among other games of a similar genre. PROGRESSION AND OPEN ECONOMY Don't let the MMO genre scare you. There are no levels in our game, and development happens by obtaining new equipment in many ways, including buying it from other players. STALCRAFT: X has an open economy, where everyone can become a famous merchant without leaving the base! By the way, there are no wipes in our game — this means that your progress will be saved forever and will not be deleted. DISTRIBUTION MODEL Our game is distributed for free, but monetisation is organised on a “Pay for time” model. Any items can be obtained in-game, but the soft monetisation method allows you to speed up some areas of character progression or get cosmetic items.
row.short_description: STALCRAFT: X is the largest open-world online game in the Chernobyl Exclusion Zone. Explore the world full of mutants and anomalies alone or with friends — unforgettable emotions guaranteed.

row.name: ModBots
row.detailed_description: In the far future, humanity has been victorious in the great war against machines. Now keeping the remaining robots in storage, some have figured that the coming destruction of them may as well be entertaining to the masses. In underground fighting arenas, players play as these robots, fighting against smaller robots and advanced gladiators to the enjoyment of the onlookers. Battle! Fight through hoards of enemy gladiator bots in the arena either solo or with friends! Upgrade! After each round, you will have the opportunity to collect loot to upgrade your bot for the next round to come. Survive! Survive wave after wave collecting new weapons and upgrading your bot’s abilities to vie for supremacy in the arena!
row.short_description: ModBots is a third-person arena rogue-like in which players play as robots fighting through randomized arena layouts against hordes of grunt robots and larger gladiators. As the players advance, they gain upgrades and weapons to enhance their abilities to fight and survive in the everchanging arena!

row.name: Short Circuit
row.detailed_description: Short Circuit is an experimental game made in the spirit of a classic award-winning Half-Life mod Earth's Special Forces. Players compete in arena maps set around various macro-sized electronics, playing classic game modes such as Team Death Match, Free For All, Capture The Flag or unique sports game modes such as Zap-Ball. Short Circuit features a unique style of movement and fighting mechanics. Players are competing against each other flying around at high speeds in open macro-sized electronics-themed arena maps, trying to catch each other with melee attacks, while optionally also competing to score points by capturing flags or doing other game-mode specific tasks. After a successful attack, player gains Charge, which can be activated at any time. And then, for a short time, players actions and properties (damage, speed, recharge rate etc.) are multiplied by the Charge Multiplier. The more charge you accumulate, the higher your Charge Multiplier is. Ever wanted to become super-saiyan? But use your Charge deliberately, its not easy to get and it drains fast! During your fight, your actions will cost you your Power, and when your power drains, you have to recharge it, but be careful, you can't move when you're recharging and you become an easy target. Managing to have your Power high, be faster and in a better position than your opponent, while also trying to get your Charge on, is where maneuvering tactics and split decisions come into play. Short Circuit aims to provide a unique PvP experience, with multiple factors that players will be able to master and win the fight based on their wits, instincts and reaction (or just pure luck)! Do you have what it takes?
row.short_description: Unique PvP flying arena fighter set around macro electronics

row.name: Marrakech
row.detailed_description: Marrakech hospital was taken by evil. A doctor who was raised by demons and born to be a problem to the world is hidden inside the hospital invoking evil creatures. Jack was called because he is the only one capable to defeat him. Use a blessed AK and other weapons to defeat these evil creatures who won't stop for nothing until they destroy all the good living things on the planet. Defeat the creatures before they get out and spread to the city. Pacients inside are surrounded by these creatures and you are their only hope. First game of the series Marrakech. Game in first person. Shoot demons with modern blessed weapons and save the patients. It's just another day in Jack's demons hunter life. Evil creatures will go after you when you get too close and chase you until you are down. Intense and dark game. Every corner danger will be closer. If you are a lightweight gameplayer this game may be too intense for you : ) Game contains some nude (buttocks exposed) and violence acts against creatures with human shape as shows weapons not indicated for kids view. Keyboard and mouse to control and move the character. Left click to shoot. Esc to access the menu. Other instructions at the beginning of the game.
row.short_description: There is a doctor possessed by demons inside Marrakech hospital, he is invoking evil creatures. Pacientes inside need your help. Use a blessed Ak and defeat the creatures that comes your way.
row.notes: Game contains some nude (buttocks exposed) and violence acts against creatures with human shape as shows weapons not indicated for kids view.

row.name: Re:サバイバー
row.detailed_description: Concept 君は砂漠に取り残された伝令、 敵の攻撃をかいくぐり、時間内に脱出地点までたどり着けるか？ ・RUN 敵兵だらけの砂漠を駆け抜け、飛行機に飛び乗り脱出せよ！ ・FIGHT 脱出を阻む敵の攻撃を避けながら、反撃して全ての敵を倒せ！ ・SURVIVE 限られた回復アイテムを上手く使い、生き残れ！ Overview ・ハードな戦場で生き延びる為に前進するシングルプレイの横スクロールシューティングゲーム ・シンプルな操作性でありながら、ジャンプ、地形による起伏、残弾数などを考えてプレイしなければならない ・撃つ、避ける、倒す、爆発！ 直感的なゲームプレイを実現する為に、ダメージのフィードバック、わかりやすいUI、戦闘システムなどを工夫。
row.short_description: Re:サバイバーはハードな戦場で生き延びる為に前進するシングルプレイの横スクロールシューティングゲームです。 シンプルな操作性でありながら、ジャンプ、地形による起伏、残弾数などを考えてプレイしなければいけない部分が特徴です。
row.notes: プレイヤーもしくは、敵の銃撃による弾が兵士に接触した際に、血のエフェクトが表示されます。

row.name: DREAM
row.detailed_description: 'An mysterious and tricky work, almost difficult to wrap your head around...' You can go at your own pace while exploring many areas of your dreams. Interacting with a particular object or character in the game gives you a item. These items can be used to change the look of the main character. Explore multiple different mesmerizing fantasy landscapes Interact with intriguing objects Complete short puzzles and mini-games Collect 16 different strange items that change the characters appearance Fight against some enemies with points and click style combat Unique music and art style Walk around using the arrow keys →←↑↓ and interact with objects with 'E'. You can open your inventory by pressing 'Esc'.
row.short_description: A 2D exploration-collectathon game with dream-like qualities.

row.name: Eraser
row.detailed_description: Throw your stick-figure-self at cannonballs and airplanes in an upward pursuit of the eraser! Eraser is a challenging game about chasing an eraser up a gauntlet of cannons, planes, and projectiles. Punch, dodge, and parry your way through the air, get sent plummeting, and do it all over again as you hone your skills. You can also play cooperatively online! If your mastery becomes too great, attempt the hard mode where enemies are more aggressive and falls are more punishing. Play online to share the struggle with your friends! Will you save your peers by parrying them in their time of need? Or will you be the one that sent them flying in the first place? Eraser was originally made in 10 days for the LudwigJam game jam!
row.short_description: Throw your stick-figure-self at cannonballs and airplanes in an upward pursuit of the eraser! Play cooperatively online to share the journey! Who's to say whether the company will help or hinder, though...

row.name: Unriddle
row.detailed_description: Social Deduction & Battle Royale One player starts as the illusionist and tries to kill everyone. Others try to identify the illusionist. If the illusionist dies, they leave an orb behind. When a player takes the orb, they become the illusionist. Skills suited for assasination... ...and mind games. Positional Voice Chat You can only speak with players near you. Dead players can't speak. No In-Game Purchases. No Progression. It's a simple game. Pick a name, customize your character, and join or create a lobby. Features Top down camera Right-click movement Skills with cooldowns Can unlock skills by collecting stars Fast paced gameplay thanks to short rounds Chat box communication for those not preferring voice
row.short_description: One random player starts as the illusionist. Their objective is to kill everyone using assasination and stealth skills. The last player standing for two consecutive rounds wins the game.

row.name: Huygens Principle
row.detailed_description: Huygens Principle is a 2D top-down shooter where you become the enemy that you killed. All you want is revenge. And you are going through space, time and hell for this. Features Fast-paced and hardcore gameplay where you must not only shoot but make decisions in every moment. Who will be next? Who am I going to become? Neat synthwave soundtrack with 16 tracks from ALEX, CYBERCORPSE, Dupre, EMMETT BROWN, Reno and Wice. 169 levels in 13 chapters. Each chapter takes place in a unique location with its own style and music. When you complete the first tutorial chapter all chapters are unlocked. The chapter can be selected on chronological timeline at the bottom of 'Play' screen. You can play chapters in any order but it's recommended to follow numerical one. Different types of gameplay: slow-mo, no powers and chapter where time moves when you move.
row.short_description: You become the enemy that you killed!

row.name: Mr.Addon in Sulpicius Gallus M
row.detailed_description: Mr.Addon is a cosmic renegade who has come to a section of the Sulpicius Gallus M crater to help awaken the 'Big Human' who remains asleep within. He accompanies Mr. Addon on this not-for-the-faint adventure, where he will battle system maintenance technicians, Dominion aliens, and replicating cyborgs. Use your powers to bring together what is above and what is below by turning your enemies into exploding moons! Complete the 3 levels in a row and kill their 3 final bosses. Use the elements, ice, fire, teleportation portals and solve the “sharp” puzzles of this adventure, while you enjoy viewing the pictorial work of Peláez Ochoa and the musical work of unTIL BEN. Are you coming with Mr. Addon to the Moon? Regarding the gameplay, MrAddon is an incredible 2D platform game, whose mechanics consists of eliminating all the enemies in each level, as well as a boss that is at the end of each world for 3 worlds. Being able to play in an 'Arcade' mode or in the 'Level Selection' mode. The game cannot be saved and the 'continues' are limited. The difficulty increases as the game progresses, mainly due to the dangerousness of the enemies and the structure of the screen, where many times you have to find out the best way to solve the level. To eliminate all the enemies of the level, it is achieved by throwing them multi-frequency 'rainbow' rays, which is the special ability of the MrAddon character, thus turning them into 'Moons', 'Snow balls' or 'Fire balls' and then rolling them to eliminate more enemies. An adventure created by fans of the mythical Arcade game Snow Bros.
row.short_description: Mr.Addon is a cosmic renegade who has come to a section of the Sulpicius Gallus M crater to help awaken the 'Big Human'

row.name: Jumpy Haha
row.detailed_description: Jumpy Haha is a result of my 2021 new years resolution to learn Unreal Engine. It is a 3D platformer that is made to be completed as fast as possible. The main mechanic is jumping and boosting into walls. Bouncing off a wall gives you some speed and another boost. You can also repeatedly jump and boost into the ground to gain extra speed. There are a ton of short cuts in the levels that are possible Thanks to Zach Paquette for modeling the character!! Here are my times:
row.short_description: Indie 3D Platformer/Speedrunner. Honestly super frustrating to play but I did my best

row.name: Destructor Tanks
row.detailed_description: Destructor Tanks 3D is a fast-paced arcade racing game where you drive miniature tanks around larger-than-life, destructible environments. Welcome to Destructor Tanks 3D, where tiny tanks race around giant maps set on pool tables and plant boxes. Outplay your rivals by speeding, drifting, shooting and blocking them with environmental hazards as you fight your way to first place. Play against your friends in intense four-player online multiplayer matches and aim for the top of the leaderboard. With a variety of tank models and colours to choose from, race your way in the debut title from Spindrift Studios. KEY FEATURES Take a trip down the fast lane – Jump right into the first map, Billiard Blitz with up to three friends and battle for first place. Shoot your way to the top – Take down your rivals by blowing them up or shooting the many destructible props on the map to slow them down. Race with style, in style – Drift around carefully crafted levels with tightly designed driving mechanics in two high quality tanks in a multitude of exciting colours. Show the world what you’re made of – Aim for the top of the leaderboard and show your friends who’s truly the master of vehicular combat in Destructor Tanks 3D.
row.short_description: Outplay your rivals by speeding, drifting, shooting and blocking them with environmental hazards as you fight your way to first place. Play against your friends in intense four-player online multiplayer matches and aim for the top of the leaderboard.

row.name: The Two of Us
row.detailed_description: The Two of Us is a 2D Co-op Platformer that has a strong emphasis on working together. You will be greeted with various puzzle levels where you must work in conjunction with your friend to navigate the level. The game is complete with 2D Animations, Sound Effects and PvE Combat.
row.short_description: The Two of Us is a 2D Co-op Platformer that has a strong emphasis on working together. You will be greeted with various puzzle levels where you must work in conjunction with your friend to navigate the level.

row.name: Sucker for Love: Prelude
row.detailed_description: FIND LOVE AND HORROR Put the love in Lovecraftian! We all know what it's like to be lonely. But what if you simped for the biggest E-girl (Eldritch girl) in all the cosmos? How would you even get her to notice you? Luckily, with the power of a strange pink necromincon, you have the chance to make your restless dreams into a dark and terrifying reality! GAMEPLAY Sucker for Love is a romantic visual novel with a dark twist. It's said that the heart and brain are often at odds, and SfL puts that to the test. As you woo this otherworldly beauty, try to keep your mind from spiraling into maddening insanity! Recite the incantations for the perfect date and stave off oblivion by: Performing dangerous rituals Keeping your possessive eldritch date happy Escaping from the horrors you unleash upon yourself Remember: dying once or twice is a small price to pay for a smooch from an eldritch goddess! LEGACY Sucker for Love was originally created as an exclusive for the Dread X Collection 2 . In celebration of the upcoming release of the Sucker for Love: First Date , we've made the original smash hit free for fans! Try to get win yourself a smooch from this eldritch goddess , and wishlist below to get a chance to take it to the next level!
row.short_description: Preform a series of scary rituals to win over an eldritch cutie and win a smooch!
row.notes: Suggestive themes, mild violence and gore

row.name: Bounceables
row.detailed_description: You gotta keep 'em moving! Stay focused, because they're not going to stop moving anytime soon! Stop the balls from colliding, keep 'em apart for as long as possible. Easy right? Well... put that to the test in Bounceables. Bounceables is an addictive, fun, and free-to-play game for all types of gamers, from casual to hardcore. It just takes a simple click to keep them moving, sounds easy right? What is Bounceables? Bounceables is a singleplayer and multiplayer game involving multiple balls that you need to make sure don't collide. Game mode: - Singleplayer - Take some time to get a way from the mayhem on Bounceables in singleplayer. With a variety of maps to choose from, you could be there for a while. With innovative gameplay features, multiple maps and an easy to navigate UI system. Bounceables has something for everyone.
row.short_description: Got 5 minutes? Play Bounceables! With Season 1, there's loads to play on Bounceables.

row.name: Six Braves 🕌
row.detailed_description: is a Magic Tower (fixed-value strategy RPG) game with additional elements such as Skills and Equipment, in which players take on the role of different Braves to go to the Magic-Tower and defeat the Demon King to 'save' their world! Game Features - Play Gutsy Swordsman for free! After succeeding in the High Challenge, you will also be rewarded with free unlockable [paid DLC] to play other characters! - 6 different characters, learn a variety of skills in the Tower - 53 levels of carefully designed towers, a structure that changes depending on the character, and different character plots to uncover the nature of the tower as the game unfolds - Use different characters to explore the hidden mystery of the tower, use different weapons and equipment, and create your own way through. - The carefully balanced 3 basic difficulties + 100 additional difficulty challenges allow both casual and hardcore players to enjoy the strategy of this game. - Each character has more than 2 hours of single pass time to start your strategy feast. - After raiding the tower, challenge the extremely difficult mode, maybe you are the next number one in the world in the leaderboard. - Redrawing of the classic magic tower monsters, more than 60 kinds of enemies, master the enemy skills, defeat the lord and the last demon king, to create their own adventure! Don't miss out on such a fun free game. What are you waiting for?
row.short_description: Strategy RPG game , full of childhood memories!

row.name: Vann Pete's Dive
row.detailed_description: **ALPHA RELEASE!** Click to handle the eagle to fly up and down. Avoid all in order to keep flying and earn more and more high scores, earn FlyPoints and spend it! Your objective is to keep the eagle alive for as long as you can! Just Fly!
row.short_description: Flap your way through the trees, see how many you can get though without touching them!

row.name: Stalks Stalks Stalks
row.detailed_description: Stalks Stalks Stalks Have you ever wanted to make a bunch of money? To get rich by doing nothing? To become wealthy without ever developing a useful skill or trade? What if I told you there was a game that let you live out that fantasy in a pretend world? Well, that game is Stalks Stalks Stalks! Compete against your friends, strangers, or no one and try and buy and sell stalks to make money. The player with the highest number wins! Everyone else loses! If you get the highest number, congratulations! If you get the lowest number, well, at least you didn't lose anything of real value... Features Buy stalks Sell stalks Collect dividends Take out loans Pay your loans Default on your loans Go bankrupt Up to 10 players in a game The game can also be played 'single player.' Simply create a lobby, ready up, and then click start game to enjoy a nice, relaxing, solo stalks adventure! A thorough 'how to play' write up can be found on itch.io and in the Game Manuals CardConquest Also include is the beta of CardConquest , a two player, turn based strategy game where players try and capture their opponent's base or destroy all their units. Choose between the Infantry Commander and Tank Commander and fight for supremacy on your tiny island. There is no luck or RNG involved in winning battles. It is all based on your armies combined power, which is modified by the card each player chooses to modify their attack power. Cards can have special abilities that will alter the outcomes of battles if specified conditions are met. Good luck battling! Note: This game is in beta. Two player online multiplayer only. No singleplayer version available Features Turn based strategy Choose between two 'commanders' - different numbers of units and different cards Reinforce battles from adjacent tiles - choose wisely! Cards are played to modify battle outcomes Strategically sacrifice cards to maintain higher powered cards Destroy enemy units with your card's attack power (the sword sprite) You can always see what cards your opponent has available before a battle. Plan accordingly! A thorough 'how to play' write up can be found on itch.io and in the Game Manuals. I also created a game development blog/tutorial for creating CardConquest, which you can read through here: Additionally, the source code for CardConquest is available on github: Between the two, you can see for yourself just how bad I am at coding! Sound effects obtained from
row.short_description: Stalks Stalks Stalks is a turned based, competitive, 'stock simulation' where you hope to make more money than every one else. If you play by yourself, you'll always win! Try your luck against friends or strangers, and you'll likely lose!

row.name: PHANTASIA
row.detailed_description: In 2020 We Started The Adventure To Phantasia Via Film/Instrumental Project And Now We've Reached Our Destination In VR! .. You Can Explore And Travel Around PHANTASIA Unlocking Your Imagination! (PHANTASIA VR IS MORE OF ART THAN AN ACTUAL GAME .. ITS APART OF THE OVERALL PHANTASIA UNIVERSE)
row.short_description: Escape To PHANTASIA!

row.name: Rapture - The Beginning
row.detailed_description: Story: You play as a famous archeologist and explorer who is venturing through an ancient temple in the middle of the desert. In his endeavor to find the great ancient treasure, he has to overcome the puzzles that are blocking his way. The road to the great treasure is protected by many deadly traps, and he will have to act quickly and use his skills wisely to overcome the obstacles and survive. The big temple walls hide one more deadly secret - the Ancient Guardians. The Game: Rapture - The Beginning is a platform adventure game based on solving logical puzzles and avoiding traps while carefully timing your movement and actions Key Features: - Player will explore a full 3D constructed world of an ancient desert temple following motives from Egyptian mythology - Player will face light logical puzzles, as the game progress, the difficulty of the puzzles will gradually increase - Player will face a different variety of traps, such as arrow projectiles, falling blocks, floor traps, enemies, massive contraptions that destroy everything in their way and much more - The carefully crafted world interacts with the player from all directions (traps, puzzles, enemies), leading to a unique experience
row.short_description: Rapture - The Beginning is an atmospheric adventure puzzle game in which you play as a famous archeologist and explorer who is venturing through an ancient temple in the desert, using his skills to overcome the traps, enemies and all obstacles in his way in search for the great ancient treasure

row.name: Hover The Edge
row.detailed_description: Sometime in the future, you're hired by a well-funded group of individuals that uses time travel to cautiously extract ancient artifacts from secret locations just before they are destroyed by an apocalyptic event, not to mess with the timeline, of course. As an Extractor in Hover The Edge, you'll be dispatched to an exotic island to recover the Sword of Souls, a weapon forged in another dimension to protect the human world from otherworldly threats, you'll be armed with a futuristic hoverboard and a combat suit, these will allow you to recover the artifact and return to base before the apocalyptic event. Extracting isn't easy but it sure is exciting! Use your body movements with snowboarding-like balance control to steer while boosting, jumping or flying through beautiful locations, dodge deadly obstacles and collect pickups which, with some luck, may make the journey easier for you. Hover The Edge's gameplay is challenging, exciting and quite intense, in the game, you'll be hovering through Kamilu Island which consists of several changing environments which are randomly generated using your body movements to steer and your controllers to boost, break and jump to avoid deadly obstacles and collect pickup items. *Please take it easy at first if you tend to get motion sickness in VR.
row.short_description: A fast-paced and challenging VR, hoverboard based adventure, you're an extractor for a well-funded group of individuals who manipulate the past to hunt for ancient artifacts.

row.name: Momotype
row.detailed_description: The monotype, an off-shoot virtual pet, is being play-tested by members of your company. You have been selected. An experimental, retro take on tamogotchi-lite games. Will you fulfill Momo's needs or does he need something greater? Features Original art. Approximately 10,000+ words. 30-40 min for each playthrough. Ambient/ lo-fi soundtrack. 3 separate endings and one secret ending. IMPORTANT: Mainline narrative progresses with each play-through Rimatoad: Writer, Programmer, Artist, Musician, and UI Glazed Goose: Programmer and UI Twitter GitHub ​Amaranthine: Musician, Track: Ebb and Flood Twitter ​ Website ​ Thanks to Rose for the music track, 'Weekly Fair'! Twitter Website ashi_yuri: Japanese translation mod/ 日本語化パッチ Twitter Website 日本語化パッチ Note: Momotype changes with each play-through. The 'reset' button reverts the play-through counter to zero, and the play-through proceeding this action will not reflect any new changes .
row.short_description: An experimental, horror visual novel about raising a virtual pet. Help a tamagotchi-like creature navigate his angst. We love Momo!
row.notes: This game is not suitable for children. Themes of horror and suicide.

row.name: Bounce Ball: Neon Party Arcade
row.detailed_description: Bounce Ball: Neon Party Arcade is reimagining a videogame classic: Play virtual table tennis with up to 4 players in a futuristic visual style using new gameplay elements like power ups and randomly generated arenas. Experience a fast-paced multiplayer game in which even the arena can change from moment to moment. Will you keep cool and come out on top? Bounce Ball: Neon Party Arcade has been developed by an interdisciplinary team of students as a semester project within a time frame of four months. We hope you enjoy our final results! A video game classic reimagined Chances are, you know the drill: You have a paddle to guard your goal. There is a ball. You try your best to bounce that ball into your opponent's goal. But what if there are not two players, but four? Three balls instead of one? Not to mention items, arena elements – and did you know that the arcade sometimes likes to change? More players! More items! More chaos! More fun! Up to four players Invite your friends and have fun in the chaotic arena of Bounce Ball: Neon Party Arcade. Supporting both multiple controllers and all-on-one-keyboard amateur wrestling, you can play it whenever you have friends around. And should your friends not be available, you can play against three different difficulties of AI opponents. Your friends do have time, but they live too far away? No need to worry, as Bounce Ball: Neon Party Arcade supports Steam Remote Play Together! Only you have to own the game to play with up to three friends via the internet. Chaos ensues Do you think four players in one arena is not enough chaos? So do we! That's why we added a bunch of items, both to help you and to hinder your opponents. Make the next goal count twice as much! Switch out the arena elements! Boost your paddle speed! And if that is not enough, there are the arena elements. They spawn randomly at the start of the game and might reflect your shot in a totally unexpected way. But they might also be perfect to hit your opponent from a different direction. Just be careful to keep an eye out or you will be the one who gets hit! Multiple game modes to keep things fresh You think you have mastered the game? Are you beating your friends in every match? Why not change it up by making the paddles smaller or speeding up the ball! You can have multiple balls, turn items on and off and even have the arena change at random. You can also choose between the two radically different modes of Score, where you try to get the most points before a timer runs out, and Survival, where you have a limited amount of lives. But don't worry if your friends are the ones who are always beating you: Even when you have lost all your lives, you will still be able to participate and make their lives harder with well timed items.
row.short_description: Bounce Ball: Neon Party Arcade is reimagining a videogame classic: Play virtual table tennis with up to 4 players in a futuristic visual style using new gameplay elements like power ups and randomly generated arenas.

row.name: AGNI
row.detailed_description: What is this world, vast and unknown? What is this mysterious cat looking for? You will explore biomes in rich and diverse landscapes, where each area offers unique visuals and music. Our worlds are randomly generated, so each adventure you make will be different and unique. Along the way, you'll come across items to pick up, and even surprises to download. The game's original music has randomized musical arrangements: each part launches a different overlay of melodic, harmonic and percussive elements. And each biome has its own arrangement, so put on your headphones and enjoy the adventure! AGNI is an easy game to play, with different difficulties for its environments for the more experienced gamers. To extend AGNI's experience, play the endless mode that unlocks in the middle of the adventure. There you will find magical items in the store to increase the fun and make the best score possible! Features: - three different environments - an infinite number of runs and music - endless mode with a store
row.short_description: AGNI is a runner game, help a mysterious cat to collect fragments through different landscapes and enjoy an endless mode for scoring!

row.name: Pwnk: Stream Battle Royale
row.detailed_description: Engage live audiences and grow your stream with a variety of funny community games Pwnk Royale & Olympwnks are the main game mode: Create your own live game show using Pwnk's mini-game battle royale! Your audiences will be able to play with you in real-time, create funny live content together, and even help you battle against other streamers! Pwnk supports all the biggest streaming platforms: Twitch, Youtube, Facebook Gaming Also 30+ variety games with frequent updates PWNK Ball: It's like Pong but viewers can participate by pitching the ball. PWNK Rescue: Which streamer can save the most birds? PWNK Draw: Can you guess what the streamers are drawing together? Pwnk Defense: Pwnk Defense is a tug of war strategy game between 2 teams. Pwnk Snack: Can you guess which colored snack has the most area in the box? Pwnk Blitz: Can you quickly pick the correct matching item? Pwnk Doll: Can your eyes keep track of Russian Doll? Pwnk Away: Can you find who is away? Pwnk Raid: Can you raid the most coins? Pwnk Places: Can you guess where I am? Pwnk Relations: Can you guess their relationship? Pwnk Defense: Defend your team‘s base and destroy your enemies! Pwnk Life: Live your best life possible! A text-based life sim Pwnk Crossplay: Can you guess crossdressing or not? Pwnk GameWorld: Can you guess what game I'm playing based on the game map? Pwnk & Count: Can you count how many characters are remaining? Pwnk Food: Can you guess the country or territory by the food? Pwnk Products: Can you guess are these products real or not? Pwnk Man: Which viewer will become the biggest Pwnk Man? Pwnk Mandela: Can you guess the correct Logo and characters? Pwnk Loot: Can you guess the correct video game by game items or loot! Pwnk 90s: Does this belong to the 90s? Pwnk Animals: Does this animal exist? Pwnk Actor: Can you guess the movie by actor! Pwnk Who: Guess whose is it? Guess the character by the item shown in the image. Pwnk Nation: Guess the nation by the item shown in the image. and many more! Around 2-8 new games will be added to the collection each month. All games are Free and easy to play. Are you a streamer? You can play Pwnk with your viewers and with another streamer's chat. Pwnk is very community-oriented and brings people together in existing streamer's communities.
row.short_description: Pwnk has a wide variety of community games to engage your live audiences and grow your stream. Create your live game show using Pwnk's mini-game battle royale! Your audiences will be able to play with you in real-time, create funny content, and even help you battle against other streamers!

row.name: The Missing Parts of Maria Gwozdek
row.detailed_description: Maria's life is falling apart: she's lost her job, her landlord wants her out, and her mother is sick. As she struggles to keep her head above water, Maria is approached by a mysterious figure who offers her an unusual deal. The stranger will fulfill any of Maria's wishes. But for each wish granted, they demand a horrifying payment: one of Maria's organs. Will the gruesome deal fix Maria's life? And at what cost? Make terrifying choices that will change the course of Maria's life Navigate Maria's broken relationships as she harbors a dark secret Explore four endings depending on what Maria decides to wish for Uncover a secret ending that changes everything Remastered version of the 2016 original with HD graphics and additional content Around 30 minutes per playthrough Blind accessible: press V to activate self-voicing mode
row.short_description: The Missing Parts of Maria Gwozdek is a dark fantasy visual novel about fulfilling your aspirations by sacrificing parts of yourself. Literally.
row.reviews: “The Missing Parts of Maria Gwozdek packs a lot of punch in just 20 minutes of narrative interaction.” Cheap Boss Attack “Horrifying, yet enthralling.” Gaming in Pajamas “A very well written and unsettling story ... Poses some interesting dilemmas and goes to very dark places. Highly recommended.” Free Game Planet
row.notes: Trigger warning for the following: textual descriptions of violence and body horror; brief description of a failed attempt at non-consensual sex; alcohol use.

row.name: The Pest
row.detailed_description: Johnny is a funny and friendly guy. He is curious, clever and ingenious. And also, he's a virus... Yeah, literally a computer virus, seriously. Like a dangerous computer virus meant to send the world into chaos... Do you think it can be a problem? Johnny is the unique computer virus designed to adapt to challenges he encounters. So on your way to the Core, you will need all three of Johnny's forms: Standard square form - average speed and jump height but stronger than other forms so is able to move objects Tall form - low speed and high jump height, the best to drop through narrow spaces or get to high places Flat form - high speed and low jump height, can squeeze under a low ceiling and fast enough to avoid dangers You will need to understand all three forms to help Johnny on his path. Octagon - is the headquarters of the World Security Organisation, which is responsible for order and control over the world. And now Johnny is on his way to the Core of the global security system. Just imagine what a disaster can be caused by a pest in such a system. But never mind, the system is protected with lasers, traps and unbitable puzzles, and any pest wouldn't be able to squeeze inside. They are sure of it, but with ingenuity and sleight, any system isn't impenetrable ;) So, as we accompany Johnny on his journey, maybe we should stop him? Possibly destroying the world is a bad idea? But the Programmer created Johnny with a purpose, how can 'son' go against his 'father'? Why should the world be destroyed? Oh, so many questions. I have a headache. Please, go and find your own answers in hidden parts of the system's labyrinths and help Johnny make the right decisions.
row.short_description: Solve challenging puzzles and avoid dangerous traps of the computer defence system in this puzzle-platformer game about a tiny optimistic computer pest heading to the System's Core. Will he plunge our world into chaos, or will he have mercy? It's up to you.

row.name: *NEW* SCUFFED BHOP SIMULATION 2026 GOTY EDITION
row.detailed_description: *NEW* SCUFFED BHOP SIMULATION 2026 GAME OF THE YEAR EDITION (POG CHAMP) is the sequel to *NEW* SCUFFED EPIC BHOP SIMULATOR 2023 (POG CHAMP), This game is focused on expanding on features that we have built in the first game while providing all brand new features, including new Single Player content, new multiplayer modes and new maps! Singleplayer content has been heavily expanded on since the first game. We have included a lot of new content as well as remade and revamped maps from the previous game. First of all This game will feature a campaign, you are the Scuffed Bean. and the world is under threat by a device that will unscuff everything in the world, and destroying all of the Scuffed Beans in the process. Will you be able to get to the device in time? Only you can find out when you experience this fast pace campaign for yourself. On top of the campaign we have Using Scuffed technology we have produced stunning new maps for you to lay your eyes on. Please take a look at these brand new maps that are built from the ground up for *NEW* SCUFFED BHOP SIMULATION 2026 GAME OF THE YEAR EDITION (POG CHAMP) On top of all the new Single Player content to experience for the first time, you can play with your friends with all new multiplayer content for you and all of your friends (if you have any) to enjoy We have a lot of *NEW* Multiplayer modes to talk to you about! So stay tuned! Closing Overview Jump into *NEW* SCUFFED BHOP SIMULATION 2026 GAME OF THE YEAR EDITION (POG CHAMP) when it releases in Q1 of 2022. We are super excited to share more gameplay as release of the game comes closer
row.short_description: The long-awaited sequel to the hit game *NEW* SCUFFED EPIC BHOP SIMULATOR 2023 (POG CHAMP) is here! All new SinglePlayer maps with popular maps returning from the first game! Play online multiplayer cross platform with all new modes and experiences!

row.name: Forest Star
row.detailed_description: RPG Maker MZ Game Jam 'Touch the Stars' Forest Star won third place in the official RPG Maker MZ Game Jam 'Touch the Stars.' About the Game Guide a monkey across a forest to find a fallen star! Meet interesting, amusing, and occasionally hostile characters who may help or hinder you. Choose from three different companions - including an owl and a tortoise - whose unique characteristics open up new possibilities, or try going solo! Find items that you can use to replenish your health, solve your problems, or decorate your home. Gain experience and discover new abilities as you level up. See different outcomes depending on your choices, and unlock four different endings! Playtime: About 20-30 minutes. Note: This game was made for the Touch The Stars game jam (hosted by Komodo), where it won 3rd prize!
row.short_description: Help a monkey find a fallen star in this short adventure game! Meet and recruit other animals, find useful items, and discover new abilities. Multiple endings available depending on your choices!

row.name: Berry
row.detailed_description: RPG Maker MZ Game Jam 'Touch the Stars' Berry won first place in the official RPG Maker MZ Game Jam 'Touch the Stars.' About the Game Berry is a short orthogonal 3D platformer centered on delivering light bullet-hell challenges and precise projectile manipulation using its unique web-orbiting systems. Fight unique bosses and unlock new abilities in this tiny Metroidvania adventure! Welcome! Welcome! Embark on a small and crunchy adventure up Yamakuu mountain's somewhat treacherous terrain to reach an illumination brighter than any spider has ever achieved. Explore over 50 maps and combat multiple bosses while platforming, dodging, and vibing within the world of bugs. Try and consume all the flies hidden throughout the world! New Features! As the 1st place winner of the Touch the Stars game jam, Berry was already packed with tons of challenging and unique platforming mechanics; however, upon being published to Steam, Berry has been updated with new features based on user feedback! Collect hundreds of NOMI spread across the world to spend on newly added shops! Track down each of the 4 terrains’ shops, each with unique items that provide new combat, cosmetic, and utility capabilities to your tiny spider! Make use of the new shield system! Either use the shields to provide yourself with additional health or find methods to dispose and gain more NOMI! There are now a total of 20 flies hidden in the world! The more you collect, the more powerful your abilities become. Added a complete options menu and the ability to reference the game controls from the pause menu. Multiple Endings! Depending on the number of flies that are collected and consumed, the game may end with any of the 5 available endings (with a 6th true ending that requires additional conditions to be fulfilled). Will you remain a weak spider for the sake of the mindless flies? Or will you consume everything in your path and become an unstoppable force?
row.short_description: Berry is a short orthogonal 3D platformer about a tiny, blue spider. Gain new abilities, weave through projectiles, collect and purchase a variety of items, and combat various bosses in this tiny metroidvania adventure.

row.name: Lemon Run
row.detailed_description: This is an Impossible runner where you can play In 5 game modes. Easy, Medium, Hard, Impossible and Endless. The goal is to get a score of 1000 for the difficulties levels and you play against your high score in the Endless level. (Legends have it that the creator of the game could only make it to 1500m in endless mode) Good luck! You can use the AWSD keys or the arrow keys and the space bar can also be used to jump. This is Lemon Tree Studio Inc.'s first mini-game and was made by Joel Diab. This is not a AAA game so you might find bugs here and there. Just know that everything was made with love and passion and this won't be my last game!
row.short_description: Hardest runner ever! Try and complete all 5 game modes that go from easy to impossible. (Legends have it that the creator of the game could only make it to 1500m in endless mode) Good luck!

row.name: Legend of the Phoenix
row.detailed_description: Legend of the Phoenix is an Otome dress-up mobile game which focuses on ancient Chinese love stories. As the main female character, with every choice that you made at the fork road, there will be ups and downs.During your beautiful journey in the game, you will get to meet different kinds of confidants, and choose your destiny in multiple romantic relationships. At the same time, you will experience dreamlike ancient scenery, the day and night changes of the gorgeous palace scenery bring you an immersive experience. Players will also experience the fabulous traditional costumes from different countries, and players can freely design unique costumes. Game with an adorable pet orange meow, and you will not feel lonely. Other interesting and diverse game-play systems will give you the best experience. Put on the most gorgeous clothes, confess your love to him, understand each other more, and relive the love that you were expecting. [Game Feature] --Palace Battle-- The dreamlike ancient Chinese Palace background and love stories take you to understand the culture of palace battle --Perfect Match-- Multiple romantic relationship simulator, who is your destiny? --Stylish Costumes-- Play as a stylist to unlock fabulous styles with variety of costume and accessories with free combination, you're free to easily accentuate your personality in-game. --Creative Makeup-- Choose the best makeup plan to create a classic beauty --Varied Scene-- Gorgeous scenes with time variation bring you perfect immersion experience --Pet System-- The adorable Orange Meow is good at fishing, catching mice, and sorting fruits. Game with an adorable pet, you are not alone --Develop Talents-- Raising a baby with your confidante, and accompany the baby to grow up until marriage --Guild System-- Build your second home, and join hands with guild besties to fight for the strongest guild! --Ancient Society Simulator-- Experience ancient life, enjoy a leisure life, create your sweet home, and experience realistic simulations such as buying a house and farming --Ranking-- PK with players from cross-server to see who is the final winner [Follow us to get news and updates] Official Community: Bonbon-Gaming Community, join it to get gifts Official Facebook： Complaint Email: complain@modo.com.sg Contact Customer Service: cs@modo.com.sg Business cooperation: business@modo.com.sg ※The game is a free to play game, but there are also paid services such as purchasing virtual game coins and items in the game.
