row.short_description: Start your palace love journey

row.name: Jane The Reaper
row.detailed_description: The protagonist, who has immunity from the virus, protects himself from climate change in the desert. Protect and collect data, search for vaccines, complete missions, develop It is an action arcade game that develops weapons.
row.short_description: 3D action side-scrolling game with a disaster story.

row.name: Fighting Mad Lads
row.detailed_description: Fighting Mad Lads is a fast-paced party game, for two to four local players set in “Neo-City” where the rules are changing each round. It’s time to fight! Keep up with the fast pace and adapt yourself to the rules of each mini-game. Choose your street hero and destroy your friends in each game to become the King in the Streets. 1) Start a game with your friends. 2) When the game starts, elbow your friends. 3) In the middle of the game, stand in front of the screen to stop them from playing. 4) That’s it! You won! We promise you a 100% win but we are not responsible for the loss of friendships. Also, do not forget : No holds barred in the street. - Local Multiplayer : Play as one of the street heroes and dive into fun and dynamic couch games in free-for-all or pair up fights in 2v2 in the streets of Neo City. - Lots of mini games : 5 exciting mini-games alternating each round! You’ll have to adapt yourself constantly to the new rules. Will you manage to take the coin and put it in your bank in the arcade arena or will you take cover in area overload ? - Blow up your friends : Mixing party games and fighting, don’t forget to punch your friends and jump into the action. - Easy-to-Learn : FML is a game mixing party game and fighting mechanics but with very simple controls in a fast-paced rhythm. - Set in a cyberpunk 3D universe mixing street art and cartoon style.
row.short_description: Fighting Mad Lads is a fast-paced party game, for two to four local players set in “Neo-City” where the rules are changing each round. It’s time to party & to fight ! Challenge your friends through 5 mini-games and become the new King of the streets (and the master of the couch).

row.name: Basault VR
row.detailed_description: BASAULT VR is a virtual reality movement shooter. Run, jump, swing around on your grappling hook and shoot with a variety of complex yet familiar firearms. Use those tools to survive and reach the end of this roguelite! *WARNING: do not play if you are prone to motion sickness* WAIT... WHAT AM I SUPPOSED TO BE DOING? This game is a roguelite. Your goal is to survive a series of hand designed arenas against tough ennemies with your mobility and weaponry and reach the end of the cycle to unlock new Etheral Weapons! _________________________________________________________________________________________________________ ...ETHERAL WEAPON? WHAT'S THAT? An Etheral Weapon is a special type of gun that you can always spawn from behind your hips. Whether your gun is empty, you dropped it off a cliff or you just want to dual wield because that's the kind of cool dude you are, you can pull out these single magazine weapons to get you out of a bind! _________________________________________________________________________________________________________ 18 UNIQUE ARENAS... ...made for the sole purpose of shooting, running and swinging around in. _________________________________________________________________________________________________________ 10 UNIQUE GUNS... ...and more to come. Enjoy the entirely physical reloading and handling! _________________________________________________________________________________________________________ THANK YOU Making this game alone would be quasi-impossible if it wasn't for the help of these people and ressources. Please look them up and give them some love by clicking on 'Visit the website' on the sidebar :)
row.short_description: BASAULT VR is a virtual reality movement shooter. Run, jump, swing around on your grappling hook and shoot with a variety of complex yet familiar firearms. Use those tools to survive and reach the end of this roguelite!

row.name: Raia Nova
row.detailed_description: In this world, a great tournament was created by the sage Sagathu. But when a mysterious mind wipe spell causes fighting, chaos, and memory loss, you begin to see there is much more happening beneath the surface. The world seems full of strange happenings. Investigate the frozen fortress holding the power of the Breaker. Enter the terrifying dream world of Dhalia, the flower that draws blood. Face the greatest magic user alive beneath the spires of the Shining City. Raia Nova is challenging ARPG that lets you build and evolve your character as you progress. Destroy hordes of enemies with bombs, fireballs, earthquakes, ice beams, bubbles, magic daggers, plastic discs, crystal shards, plasma, and over 100 other abilities. Items often grant abilities but you'll have to find them, or improvise with whatever you have. Take on big bosses and develop your strategies against them. More than just fighting through levels, experience a variety of mission types and challenges. Choose your character - Krin the Spellsword, Mothball the Magician, Basa the Gladiator, Dias the Thief, and Dweller the Warden An Ultra skill for each character. Become invincible or rampage as a living statue. A large character progression tree for each character, customize what they excel at and add bonuses to abilities. A multitude of skills and items with little restriction on how they can be combined or used. Simple skills can be enhanced with many effects. Shoot a triple shot bullet that bounces off walls and causes the plague. 48+ levels across 6 regions of the world. Past the campaign, a challenging endgame. Supports gamepad, click to move, and WSAD control types.
row.short_description: Combine skills with many effects at once to destroy your enemies. Choose your hero and evolve them into a customized champion as you encounter strange monsters and unique characters in this crazy colorful ARPG.
row.notes: Blood and violence. Fanservice. Adult language. Mature themes.

row.name: Christmas Mansion
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Christmas Mansion! Welcome to Christmas Mansion, a cozy and festive holiday match-3 puzzle adventure where snow sparkles, gingerbread crunches, and every match brings the spirit of Christmas to life.   A Cozy Winter Match-3 Wonderland Escape into a world of twinkling lights, snowy rooftops, and festive melodies. Match candy canes, ornaments, stockings, stars, and gingerbread cookies in hundreds of levels. Every puzzle brings you closer to rebuilding and decorating the Winterland! Perfect for relaxing by the fireplace anytime you need a cheerful break.   Swap, Match & Make Holiday Magic Use simple match-3 mechanics - swap, drag, and match - to create colorful combos and festive explosions! Blow away snow piles, melt icy tiles, and clear all obstacles as you progress through magical winter puzzles.   Restore & Decorate the Winter Lands Swap pieces, beat levels and help Elf decorate the winter lands. An exciting adventure and quests wait for you. Build a cozy little cottage on the hill and a cookie factory, fire up the oven and get baking! Think you could whip up a nice batch of muffins? Build an ornament factory, ski workshop and complete dozens of other quests to prepare a fantastic holiday party. Winter has tons of fun in stock for you.   Create the Gingerbread decoration telling the tale of Hansel and Gretel! Clean the scene first! Start building! Build the witch's castle! Blast through the puzzles and have a fantastic Christmas holiday again! Magical Features You’ll Love • Dozens of quests to complete. • Powerful boosters and festive bonuses. • Hundreds of joyful holiday match-3 levels with new obstacles. • Cozy, cheerful visuals and relaxing seasonal music.   The Perfect Holiday Puzzle Adventure Whether you love Christmas games, decoration adventures, or classic match-3 puzzles, Christmas Mansion brings all the winter cheer to your screen! Warm cocoa energy + relaxing puzzles + festive decorating = The ultimate Christmas escape! Download Christmas Mansion today and let the holiday magic begin!
row.short_description: Dive into Christmas Mansion! Blast through snowy match-3 levels, unlock boosters, and help the Elf rebuild Winterland. Decorate cozy cottages, craft treats, and enjoy a joyful holiday journey filled with winter magic!

row.name: Legacy of Aeroja
row.detailed_description: Legacy of Aeroja is a game made in RPG Maker MV that uses the ABS Plugin by Phoenix_Ru.86/PhoenixKageDesu. It is made up of five major story acts and a postgame. It is rich with side content and dungeons that contain puzzles and bosses. It has many classic RPG mechanics such as hidden bosses, unique equipment and skills, rewarding exploration of side content, and is equally as rich with story, lore, and worldbuilding. It is the first game in the LoA franchise, a fantasy world filled with backstory that combines positive aspects of both realistic fantasy and high fantasy to generate a world filled with political intrigue, culture, the impact of fantasy elements in realistic societies, and many small details that give the world life. This world is a vehicle for meaningful stories following themes not often discussed in fantasy such as toxicity or modern existential problems, and will utilize ludonarrative(writing told through game mechanics) elements to enhance every part of the experience. Most importantly, this world is something you can be a part of, so join us for our first foray into it! ABS Plugin by KageDesu(all needed credits in game end credits) Legacy of Aeroja is a non-commercial product. It is not endorsed by the original license holder of the ABS Plugin. Any changes made to the plugin fall under the same license agreement as the plugin.
row.short_description: Legacy of Aeroja is a Fantasy Action Rpg made in RPG Maker MV. It follows Aeroja as they go from newborn drake to full sized dragon, dealing with the loss of their parent and the harsh winter and people around them. A tale of excess awaits.
row.notes: Mature Themes, Suggested Violence.

row.name: Rezonator
row.detailed_description: Rezonator provides tools for functional linguistics, with a focus on annotating and visualizing patterns of language use in naturally occurring conversation. Rezonator supports multiple types of linguistic analysis including resonance, coreference, anaphora, syntactic dependency, topic marking, search, and concordance. Rezonator provides Unicode support for any language, including right-to-left text direction. Users can import 7 different data types, including plain text, interlinear glossed text (IGT), transcription, Elan, one-word-per-line (OWPL), and CoNLL-U.
row.short_description: Rezonator provides tools for annotating and visualizing patterns of language use in naturally occurring conversation. Rezonator supports multiple types of linguistic analysis including resonance, coreference, anaphora, syntactic dependency, topic marking, search, and concordance.

row.name: Hedgehot - Battle Strike
row.detailed_description: Hedgehot - Battle Strike : Cards in which reside magical creatures are used to challenge other users and pave a way to the top. Hedgehot - Battle Strike is a 1 versus 1 Card Game similar to the likes of Heartstone or Runeterra, where using your cards, brain and stamina, you try to defeat your opponent and bring their life points to 0. Features : Friendly Battle - Invite your friends in a lobby to challenge them to prove your skills. Online MatchMaking - Find or create a lobby for random players around the world to challenge you. Best place to refine your skills. Deck Builder - Choose your favorite cards to challenge others with. Shop - Purchase cards to upgrade your deck and create the best possible Meta. Community : You may join the Hedgehot - Battle Strike official discord to find other battlers and a place to share your experience!
row.short_description: Turn-based strategy card game where you use different creatures and spells to defeat your enemies.

row.name: Elements of Dreams
row.detailed_description: About Elements of Dreams is pixel art action role playing game (much like the original Legend of Zelda). Play as the heroine who must discover four unique powers in order to defeat her nightmares and find her purpose. Controls: Movement: Arrow Keys (or Wasd) Power: Space Menus: Mouse button Features: 9+ Levels: Venture through 9 increasingly difficult levels. 4 Unique Abilities: Defeat your foes with 1 of 4 timed abilities. Keep track of your power bar to figure out when you need to return to a statue to recharge. 13 Enemy Types: Each enemy has different attributes of speed, health, and damage. Some even have special abilities. 1 Boss: Defeat the World boss to discover your destiny. Infinite lives: Lose all your hearts? No worries, you have infinite lives. Level progression saves: Each level unlocks that level name in the Level Selection menu once you reach it. You can then save your progress for future plays via the menu. Procedural level generation: Replay (or reload) the 2nd to last level to have it generate in a different configuration with a different combination of enemies. Replay any level: Use the Level Selection menu to replay you're favorite levels again.
row.short_description: Elements of Dreams is pixel art action role playing game (much like the original Legend of Zelda). Play as the heroine who must discover four unique powers in order to defeat her nightmares and find her purpose.

row.name: Setr's Auto Battler
row.detailed_description: Build your team! Build your own fantasy team and try them out in the arena! Each turn you get to purchase units from the shop and try to get the strongest composition. Use this time wisely, buy and sell units, find the best synergies. Fight in the arena! When you have your desired team, send them to the arena and see if they succeed! The Arena is automated, you just have to sit back and watch as you fight someone else's team. Win matches to win the game! Can you build the perfect team to get 15 wins? Features 30+ playable units to build your team from! No time limit! Go grab a coffee and continue! Asynchronous online mathmaking, each time you battle someone who recently submitted their team! The game is in beta! New units, new features and updates are coming.
row.short_description: A fantasy themed casual auto battler

row.name: 魔能纪元
row.detailed_description: This game is an RPG game for placing and hanging up produced by an independent small team. It has a very interesting equipment drop mechanism, and you can experience the infinite fun of brushing equipment without taking time. When the character is fighting, there will be a set of AI system to assist the player to operate and fight automatically. When you need to control, you can also manually control the character to move and release skills. For the control of this game, we pay more attention to the matching strategy of the character's equipment and skills, which is suitable for players who are not quick to respond but have strong strategy. Therefore, you don't need to spend too much energy on character control. The game process is very casual. The equipment in the game is divided into ordinary, excellent, perfect, epic, dark gold, legend and other qualities. Higher quality has more personalized random attributes. Equipment can be obtained randomly by playing monsters. When you exit the game, you will not stop playing monsters. The character will continue to play monsters in the game. You can get a lot of equipment and various material rewards when you go online next time. In this game, there are different classes, including warrior, mage, Archer and assassin, but the skills are common to all classes. Players can choose to match them from the skill pool to form their own unique playing method.
row.short_description: An IDLE role-playing game

row.name: Magic Disc Golf
row.detailed_description: Play Disc Golf by taking control of your disc and steer it towards the basket. You will have to plan your route carefully, navigate challenging terrain and use your limited booster ability sparingly. Main features: Three 18-hole courses and one 6-hole tutorial/practice course. Up to four players playing on the same computer. Three disc types (Driver, Midrange and Putter) with varying range, handling, and stability. Challenging terrain and obstacles. Wind that will affect your disc’s range and handling. Highly customizable play settings: Customizable courses: select a course and then select which holes you want to play. Four game modes: Stroke Play, Match Play, Speed Play and Speed Match Play. In Stroke Play and Match play you need to reach the basket in as few throws as possible. In Speed Play and Speed Match Play you need to get to the basket as fast as possible. Disc steering. Enable disc steering and guide your disc towards the basket, or disable it for a more realistic experience. Disc boosting. Enable it to collect boost energy and use it to cover more ground, or leave it disabled for more challenging gameplay. Three time-of-day settings: Afternoon, evening and night. A minimap to help you plan your hole. Can be disabled for more challenging gameplay. Minor features: Discs come equipped with flashlights (naturally). High score tables. Manuals describing the game modes and game play features in detail.
row.short_description: Magic Disc Golf lets you take control of your disc and steer it towards the basket. Find the optimal route, navigate challenging terrain, and use your speed boost to cover some extra ground. Choose from three 18-hole courses and four game modes.

row.name: Cells of Immunity
row.detailed_description: Overview of the story Play as a young Thymocyte, training to become one of the primary white blood cells that protect the human body. Meet other cells in training, and find out who is talented enough to become a white blood cell and the fate of the failures. As the story progresses, you'll have the ability to control multiple types of white blood cells, such as T-Killer cells, Macrophages and neutrophils. Each with its unique strengths and weaknesses, command them correctly to overcome all obstacles caused by invading pathogens. Use the correct types of attacks against your enemies in Real-Time action-bar combat in order to defeat your enemies. To serve and protect the human body at all costs. Game Features 1-2 Hours of Gameplay 3 Acts of Story 3+ Playable Characthers 3+ Different Classes Dozens of Items, Weapon and Gear to collect! Over 10 types of encounters! Over 20 different areas to explore! Many types of attacks, elements and status conditions. Details about the game This game is an educational Role-Playing-Game, all about the human immune system. You will experience the lives of many cells involved in the immune system. Learn about the objectives of different cell types involved in the immune response, and fight against invading pathogens. Many factors in this game, such as appearances and interactions between cells, have been altered, to fit better into a game and a good story. Despite the alterations, all events and characters in this game are based upon how the human immune system works in real life, and as a result, we aim to teach everyone who plays our game a bit more about the immune system than they knew before. Furthermore, students in medical or biological areas may find this game useful to visualize the interactions within the human body. Although some amount of scientific accuracy has been lost, this makes a much easier to understand. This game has been developed by University of Warwick students, and the story has been fact-checked by Professors of Warwick, to stay relatively accurate to the actual science behind it. The development of this game has been funded by IATL of Warwick, making it accessible for everyone to play and learn from it.
row.short_description: Become a young white blood cell in training and learn how they mature and fight against invading pathogens. Team up with other types of cells, with unique strengths and weaknesses, and overcome disease for good. To serve and protect the human body at all costs.

row.name: The Open League
row.detailed_description: The Open League (TOL) is a text-based football/soccer manager game with significant integration with the Discord platform. Key features include: Nightly matches, 3-week season Full 90-minute matches are simulated nightly with play-by-play text updates streamed in our Discord server. Each universe features 30 teams organized in three leagues. Top three teams are promoted to a higher league. Bottom three get relegated. A season lasts three weeks. Youth camp During the off-season, teams attend Youth Camp with the hope to find the nexg legendary player. Camp lasts a weekend. During that time, managers use scouting reports to decide which players to bid on. Most team dynasties in TOL were built on succesful youth camp campaigns. Friendly matches Managers also have the ability to organize friendly matches against other managers. They often use the off-season to organize tournaments against other teams. Persistent teams and players At the end of the season, managers keep their teams. Players develop and decay season after season. Transfer timing is everything. Simple team management We’ve simplified club management so you don’t need to play 100s of hours to get familiar with our platform. Managers can choose between six formations, three effort levels and three different mindsets. Simple does not mean easy, beware… Negotiate transfers against humans Transfers are negotiated against human managers over Discord before deals are formalized using the TOL application. Astute dealmakers thrive in TOL. Browser-ready Our web app allows you to access your club portal from any browser (including from your phone), in case you have to make some changes from a different computer… Bots TOL uses a few friendly bots in Discord to help you manage your team. For example, you can DM your assistant Chris to ask him to send out a press release to all other clubs about your latest victorious match! Multi-timezone support The Open League supports two timezones (US PST and GMT) at the moment. This means matches are played at 7:00pm PST if you are in our US server or 7:00pm GMT if you are in our European server.
row.short_description: A social, Discord-based, football/soccer sim

row.name: Cupid Story: First Date
row.detailed_description: Cupid Story is an RPG / dating sim in the Cupid Island universe. The cupid Noelia has a mission: get the human Daniel a girlfriend in 14 days. Too bad he's got no talent at all to make her job easier. FEATURES Classical turn-based RPG battle system Stronger relationships make for stronger characters Unlock new skills as the story progresses Dates are battles Choose the right girlfriend for Daniel from 3 unique girls This game is a prologue , it features the first episode of the complete Cupid Story .
row.short_description: Cupid Story is a small RPG / dating sim in the Cupid Island universe. The cupid Noelia has a mission: get the human Daniel a girlfriend in 14 days. Too bad he's got no talent at all to make her job easier.

row.name: PC Virtual LAB
row.detailed_description: PC Virtual Lab is a video game to improve learning in basic computer concepts. Its main objectives are: Improve learning in basic computer science concepts To complement the theory seen in the classroom with an educational game that serves to fix these concepts. To provide the student with a tool that allows him/her to deepen this knowledge outside the classroom in an autonomous way. An environment where to practice and fail without risk that allows unlimited repetition.
row.short_description: PC Virtual Lab is a video game to improve learning in basic computer concepts.

row.name: Rendezvous: Shadows of the Past
row.detailed_description: Buy Rendezvous About the Game I can't remember the last time we smiled and laughed together. After our parents died, you went one way and I went another. Is this really how you want to see this through? To end up like them and hope we reunite? I just wish for once that you'd stop running, stop lying, and look me in the eyes and say you missed me. Is it really that hard to do Setyo? Can you do that, for us For what's left of our family? Rendezvous: Shadows of the Past is the prologue to the upcoming 2.5D Cyber-Noir pixel art puzzle-action adventure game by Pendopo Studios. This free adventure takes place in Bay City, following security guard Setyo starting another day of his mundane job — until a familiar face from his past resurfaces. A stunning combination of 2D hand-drawn pixel art in a 2.5D world, melded with modern effects such as dynamic lighting and bloom to bring depth and life to the city around you. Multiple paths lead to items, objects of interest, and tools that help you find your sister — and many secrets along the way! Gather clues and use everything you know to solve challenges that stand on your path to redemption. For the risk-averse, sneak around threats... or directly confront them with the (sometimes improvised) weapons available.
row.short_description: He can't escape the memories that haunt him, and soon Setyo realizes he must return to Neo-Surabaya to save what's left of his family. Experience the upheaval of Setyo's mundane life in Bay City in this action-adventure prologue to Rendezvous.
row.reviews: “Indonesian Game ‘Rendezvous’ Takes Place in a Cyberpunk Version of Surabaya” IGN SEA

row.name: Human Apocalypse: Prologue
row.detailed_description: WISHLIST! About the Game WARNING: This game contains heavy material that might make players/audience uncomfortable. An unknown deadly virus has suddenly spread. It turns people into brain eating zombies, the whole world goes into chaos, etc. You know the rest. However, in this game, a cure has been found. All the infected people have been treated and are now normal, functioning, harmless humans again. Except for one thing, the cured people’s skin color is still green. Play as a Green man. Human Apocalypse Prologue is a game set in a post-POST-apocalyptic world focusing on story, characters, decisions, and exploration. The dark, bizarre world of this game has a deep thought-provoking story, full of interesting characters to meet, a city to freely roam and explore, tough decisions to make, an original soundtrack, beautiful visuals, lots of secrets to uncover.
row.short_description: A new virus is turning people into brain eating machines, etc. You know the rest. A cure has been found and all the infected people are now normal humans again. What is the problem then? Their skin color is still green. Play as an Ex-Zombie.
row.notes: Game contains heavy content that may not be suitable for all audiences. Some topics in-game: - Racism - Depression - Suicide - Anxiety

row.name: Push Battle
row.detailed_description: Push Battle is a casual multiplayer action game. Push Battle is an action game that you can enjoy with simple operations. 'Smash', in which the character Tackles with his ass vigorously, is an exhilarating action. The game rules are simple and it is a game that you can easily enjoy. Also, the character 'Kepplin' is very cute and attractive. Use your butt to blow your opponent away!
row.short_description: casual multiplayer action game. Play easily and quickly!

row.name: Escape Master
row.detailed_description: This is a completely free jailbreak adventure casual game. You can pass the level after completing the designated tasks, but be careful with the guards on patrol. After the character is upgraded, you can improve your own attributes, such as movement, stamina, intelligence, etc., as well as various fun props and blessing systems. Come and try the challenge! -The latest update (12.24): 1. Now supports joystick operation! It is recommended to use a joystick. 2. Add Christmas theme style displays and items. -Achievement system Complete challenges to get achievement rewards -Blessing Rescue the hostages and get blessing rewards -Prop use Use items to obtain corresponding effects -Character style Choose different character styles -Character attribute points Get attribute points for character upgrades, and customize character attributes -Shop In the game, a mystery shop will appear every few levels to buy your favorite items
row.short_description: This is a completely free jailbreak adventure casual game. You can pass the level after completing the designated tasks, but becareful with the guards on patrol. After the character is upgraded, you can improve your own attributes, such as movement, stamina, intelligence, Come and try the challenge!

row.name: Sewer Rave
row.detailed_description: Hey there buddy , you've been cordially invited to the sewer for the biggest rat party ever hosted. We've got cheese, fruit, sewer water, and danger . Wander the sewer and find messed up rats , old food , and maybe buried treasure (?) . Come along and make a friend or two. SEWER RAVE is a surreal randomized exploration game where you crawl around a rat infested sewer during a giant rave. Search the labyrinthine sewers to discover games, secrets, and wisdoms meant only for rodents. Grab a cup of sludge and meet some rats! SEWER RAVE was originally released in 2018 and the classic rat game is finally here on Steam, with a whole whopping one new feature: a genuine Steam Achievement. SEWER RAVE is the kind of game that wants to confuse you. What's going on? Am I a rat or a human? Was that a bug or a feature? Is there a reason I'm down here? What am I collecting fruit for? If you like to be confused in a loud place and unsure what is going on, maybe it's the game for you. Maybe it isn't. I'd be curious if I were you. But I like weird games. SEWER RAVE has items to collect and NPCs to trade with. Maybe you can find them all? Oh yeah and there's fruit and cheese all over the place and you can pick it up. There's also platforming challenges. There's also creatures to get into fights with. Sometimes minigames. I don't remember. Have fun okay? Stay safe? Text me when you get home. Important note: currently, the Twitch integration is not functional. Sorry for those who enjoyed that.
row.short_description: Exactly what it says on the tin. Sewer Rave is a game about exploring a rat infested Rave in a Sewer. There are creatures to talk to, items to collect, fights to get into, and jams to listen to. Explore, discover secrets, and writhe.

row.name: FreestyleFootball R
row.detailed_description: 《Freestyle Football》 is an online soccer game developed by JOYCITY, a well-known Korean online sports game company. The game adopts a fashionable and flamboyant visual style, incorporating elements of street art and soccer art. In 《Freestyle Football》 you can show your individuality and charm, and also enjoy the fun of teamwork. In《Freestyle Football》your mini team will consist of 5 characters including a goalkeeper. Each player will control one character to participate in the game. There are 3 game modes in Freestyle Football: 1.4V4 mode with fast-pace. 2.Friendly game where you can play freely with your friends. 3.Breakout mode where you can enjoy the game alone.
row.short_description: 《FreestyleFootball》 is a street hip-hop animation style soccer ACG game created by JCE and published by HOGA. In the game, you will collect and play as different characters in PVP team Competition. The game mode includes 4v4 team competition and club league.

row.name: Toram Online
row.detailed_description: Toram Online, the popular smartphone game, is now available on Steam! Enjoy Toram Online on your big computer screen without having to worry about your data usage or battery! Unrestricted character creations! With more than 500 billion combinations available, feel free to create your own character to your liking! Sword? Magic? Anything you like! 'Profession', which is often the case with MMORPG, does not exist in Toram. Sword? (Magic) Staff? Bow? Halberd? Feel free to decide your own fighting style! Build & Train your character to your heart's content! Equipped with a 'Skill Tree' system enabling players to enhance and strengthen their characters as they wish. Create combos and discover your own battle style! Changeable weapons and equipment color! You can color your favorite weapon with the color you like when you obtain equipment with a 'Color Info'! Moreover, you can freely create the abilities of your equipment as you proceed further with the game...! Go on an adventure with your friends across the country! RPG (MMORPG) that can be played and connects you with your friends online across the country! The powerful monster that you fail to beat on your own could possibly be knocked down by forming a party with your friends! Let's explore the vast and beautiful 3D world with many friends! Party play even by yourself! You can even enjoy party play when you are playing alone by borrowing and battling together with other player's character known as 'mercenary' or by summoning a 'partner' from your own sub-characters! 【Story Setting】 Decades ago, the world was hit by a devastating catastrophe, crumbling the ground into pieces. The gods quickly gathered the pieces scattered in all directions and hurriedly put them together. The result, a bizarre looking world resembling a mosaic. The nation that was originally there had ceased to exist. As a result of repeated clashes of principles and interests among the 4 tribes, the people split into 4 factions. At such times, an adventurer (you) came to this peculiar world. The adventurer (you) goes through a series of adventures while meeting various people belonging to the 4 factions in the world to confront the secretly proliferating mysteries behind it...... Service performance and availability are not guaranteed when Devices do not meet the recommended system requirements Virtual machines or emulators are being used VPN(Virtual Private Network) is being used
row.short_description: The MMORPG of a massive and magnificent fantasy! Let's explore the MMO world!

row.name: Plague Lords: Witch Hunt
row.detailed_description: The thirst for easy gain leads a small mercenary squad and their employer to a lost barony in the forest, plagued by a mysterious illness. It may be a new kind of the Black Death that has spread throughout medieval Europe or the machinations of local witches. A cunning dealer tries to exploit the tragedy for personal gain and traps the mercenaries in a dangerous game.     The prelude to the Plague Lords game will introduce you to the core mechanics and set the stage for the adventures that await you in Plague Lords. Battle the infected, explore lands shrouded in a mysterious epidemic, and try to uncover its secrets!     Features Explore one of the five main game cities. Command a small squad of trained soldiers. Build your own military camp with fortifications and crafting structures. Utilize skills and constructions for three basic crafts out of the 12 in the main game. Construct, craft, and apply traps, barricades, and fortifications. Experience a powerful arsenal with a small squad of experienced and well-armed mercenaries.
row.short_description: What seemed like an easy coin leads a small detachment of mercenaries and their employer to a barony lost in the woods, afflicted by a strange disease. The prologue to Plague Lords will introduce you to the basics of the game and take control of a small squad of trained soldiers.

row.name: Survival Girls
row.detailed_description: SURVIVAL GIRLS is my tribute game to one of my favorite games, RUST. You live on an island and need to stay alive with food and water. You build your base and defend it from others, craft items and weapons for your base, build an ATV, Snowmobile or car to race around the island. Survival Girls is focused mainly on crafting, building and raiding other players compounds! Search and collect various plants and materials to craft guns and vehicles (and soon to tame animals). The game is in a very early state and I intend to add more animals and AI and other features like air drops and events . I also would like to hear from you, the players, and try and include as many of your suggestions into the game as possible. I am a Solo dev and this is my FIRST GAME! I hope you enjoy my efforts and have a good time Surviving Girl!
row.short_description: A survival, base building and crafting game. Explore the island, collect resources and defend your base. Search, craft, hunt or steal to buy weapons and vehicles. Hunt and tame animals, grow your herd and attack your enemies base. A FP/TPS survival of the fittest!

row.name: Hereford 1642
row.detailed_description: About This Project You need to be aware that this is a historic recreation project and doesn't contain any game play that you would expect from a traditional game at this point. The game should be very enjoyable from a historic stand point and for exploring the past. Thank you Join our disord Help us with development and feedback by joining the discord About the Game A historically based recreation of my home city of Hereford in England UK from the year 1642. I have pieced together a picture of the city as it once was. Take a step into 17th century life and experience history in full 3D with realistic graphics. Using period maps, illustrations and drawings, together with still existing period buildings in the City and elsewhere; A scale model of the city as it once was. Over 200 unique enterable buildings together with the the city walls and gates, the castle and the bridge over the river Wye. Beyond the gates you can travel the countryside; A 4Km * 4Km map allows you to journey and explore a mile from the city in any direction. With towering cathedrals and churches seen from miles away. A highly interactable environment awaits with many hidden gems to find. Your character lives and works in the 17th century with all that entails. Period clothes, money, tools, transport, food, language, writing, to name but a few aspects. The past is another country: they do things differently there.
row.short_description: A historically based recreation of my home city of Hereford in England UK from the year 1642. I have pieced together a picture of the city as it once was. Take a step into 17th century life and experience history in full 3D with realistic graphics. Explore the whole city and surroundings .

row.name: 枝江畔之梦
row.detailed_description: 游戏内容#GAME CONTENT# 本作品为粉丝向同人二创作品，拥有10w字以上的完整主线剧情+若干小故事、精美的角色立绘、六十余张用心绘制的剧情CG与插图。 在这场名为A-SOUL的女团的冒险中，您将要扮演的不仅仅是一位旁观者，更是一位鼓励她们坚定前行的陪伴者。 故事#STORY# 我们都是真实世界的囚徒。 迷茫、忐忑、被指点、被评价，直至无地栖身。 现在，有这样一场梦，五个女孩将要冲破“藩篱”，来一场与现实生活的交锋。 闪耀的舞台，可能就在不远的未来——一个“虚假”的未来…… 你愿意，陪我们做完这一场大梦吗？ 小游戏#META GAME# 随着故事推进，您将会进入我们精心设置的“章间游戏”，用自己的力量，帮助主角们重拾破碎的回忆。 大的要来了#BIG IS COMING# 在体验了一整个主线剧情后，制作组准备的“更大” 的惊喜，将会等待着您的进一步探索。 角色#CHARACTER# 生日：6月12日 “枝江市……早就不会下雨了。” 枝江知名傲娇大小姐，个性纯真、唱作全能，但社交能力及其糟糕，常在公共场合出糗。虽然总是一脸倔强地想要融入属于“富人”的欢愉场，但在她的内心深处，还藏着一个关于友情和爱的梦，藏着一个“不懂事的自己”对未来做出的约定。 生日：7月17日 “舞蹈就是我的生命，我是贝拉！” 安居在枝江市小角落的一名普通舞蹈老师，曾被喻为舞蹈天才，命运的不公让她离梦想越来越遥远，但她不屈于现实，仍然一步一步舞动高傲的身姿，如白天鹅般努力地向梦想前行。这天，熟悉又陌生的昔日同伴的出现，彻底打破了她“平静”的人生…… 生日：11月2日 “我的歌只为你们而唱响，我是独一无二的，不属于谁。” 枝江人气歌星“凯若”，或者三年前，她更广为流传的那个身份：女团A-SOUL成员珈乐。她拥有天使一般的歌喉和一如既往温柔的目光，却生活在隐形的“木偶线”之下，处处不得意。当美好的过去再一次撬动她的心房，梦想与现实，成为了她不得不面对的抉择。 生日：3月7日 “我有许多个梦想，最大的梦想就是能和大家永远在一起！” 流浪在枝江市周边的，小有名气的绘画高手，人们常会在各种画展邂逅她小巧灵动的身影。她待人热情、举止友善，尽管总是会因为形单影只被坏人欺负，但倘若你需要一个笑容，她一定不会吝啬。谁也不知道，她小小的身躯里，蕴藏着多少力量、多大的梦…… 生日：8月8日 “我不会后悔或者否定自己的过去，但同时，我也想紧紧抓住属于我的未来。” 枝江大学法学毕业生，目前在M国担任实习律师。某次聚会中，同事们惊异地发现，这位口才优秀、举止优雅的女士，竟然有着不输于职业偶像的歌唱和舞蹈功底。她时刻安于现实、感谢命运，却也在内心希冀着一群能够卸下防备，彼此信任的伙伴。 关注向晚，现在不晚 @向晚大魔王 关注贝拉，乐到开花 @贝拉Kira 关注珈乐，不会挨饿 @珈乐Carol 关注嘉然，顿顿解馋 @嘉然今天吃什么 关注乃琳，净化心灵 @乃琳Queen 声明#STATEMENT# 本作品为A-SOUL的二次创作同人AVG，世界观及人设不代表现实成员现状。 制作组在游戏制作及发布的过程中总收益为0，一切为了热爱。 希望您游玩愉快。
row.short_description: “她们是真实的，我才是虚拟的。” 失去了偶像的枝江市，忙碌、喧嚣，却死气沉沉，我们应该如何适应所谓的“现实”？现在，请你深呼吸，与她们共同经历、共同成长，努力找寻深藏在生活中的小惊喜，相信某一时刻，这个童话会将名为A-SOUL的女团导向最浪漫的结局。

row.name: Sabotris
row.detailed_description: Sabotris is a strategic, competitive, 3D block stacking game, but with a twist: you can sabotage your opponents, but be careful; you can also end up sabotaging yourself! Choose to play either by yourself to beat your own high score, against your friends or other players, or even against computer AI! Competitive? Yes. Casual? Also yes. You choose the level of difficulty that suits your play style. Have a relaxing game against your own score, or group up with your friends or strangers and see who can get the highest score! Though warning in advance, only play against the computer AI on the highest difficulty at your own risk... It's not just about being the fastest at the game, power ups allow you to sabotage or assist your opponents. This takes the competitive edge to the next level, where you can intentionally sabotage a single player every time, or if you find Sabotris too easy, sabotage yourself! Spectating other people can be boring, so Sabotris doesn't make you do that when you lose. Instead, you get to roam the world as a miniature cube with your other friends that also lost. You can even pretend you're in another mini-game avoiding shapes being dropped by the ones that are still playing! Whether you're a fiend of playing with others or just want to relax with your friends, multiplayer lobbies are a must. Sabotris makes lobbying with friends or strangers seamlessly simple. Just host a game, and watch people join!
row.short_description: Sabotris is a strategic, competitive, 3D block stacking game, but with a twist: you can sabotage your opponents, but be careful; you can also end up sabotaging yourself! Choose to play either by yourself to beat your own high score, against your friends or other players, or even against computer AI!

row.name: Bouncy Bunnies
row.detailed_description: Hey there, fellow bunny lovers! Are you ready to hop into some seriously fun gameplay? Bouncy Bunnies is the perfect game for a friendly race against your friends. In a colorful platform world, your goal is to be the first bunny to reach the finish line. You can take a boost to run faster, or try to find the shortest path to the goal. With 8 different levels to choose from, there's always something new to explore. But don't forget to collect those carrots along the way! They'll help you get a higher score and come out on top. And with keyboard and mouse support, as well as gamepad support, you can play however you like. But for the ultimate bunny-bouncing experience, we recommend using a controller. And don't forget - you can even host your own server and invite your friends to join in on the fun. So gather your bunny buddies and let the race begin! Features: 1-4 players 4 different bunnies to choose from 8 levels for multiplayer fun 1 level for single player action Carrot and power boost pickups to help you along the way Keyboard and mouse support, as well as gamepad support for even more options
row.short_description: Race against your friends in a colorful platform world filled with colors and fun obstacles. Take boost to run faster or try to find the most efficient path to be the first little bunny to reach the goal. Choose from 8 levels. Collect those tasty carrots to rack up a high score and come out top!

row.name: Idle Spiral
row.detailed_description: What's Idle Spiral? This is a beautiful 'Idle', 'Incremental' game based on spirals and mathematics. Your goal is to make the spiral grow longer and longer. The game is very simple, but it is very deep and can be enjoyed for a long time. How to play By buying upgrades, you can grow your spiral more efficiently. There will be a lot of mathematical equations, but don't be afraid. The upgrades themselves are not that strategic and you hardly need to understand this formula. However, as you continue to play, you will gradually come to understand the mechanics. Layered prestige mechanics The game has various reset mechanisms called Prestige (as seen in many Idle games!). Prestige resets much of the game's progression, but allow you to progress further and faster than before. Battle Spiral In Battle Spiral, your spiral is used as a weapon to fight various designs of spirals; to gain an advantage in Battle Spiral, it is important to consider what rewards to choose and in what order to fight the enemies. An extremely powerful boss with a very complex shape awaits you in the second half of the game! Challenges Challenges aim to achieve a specific goal under strong constraints. In challenges you will face debuffs, constraints, and fundamental gameplay changes while trying to achieve a certain goal. After reaching the goal, the challenge is completed and you receive big rewards. Endless Content Tornado Prestige is just the beginning of this game. It will take some time to progress through the game, but more content is waiting for you! Music by AKIYAMA HIROKAZU from H/MIX GALLERY
row.short_description: This is a beautiful 'Idle', 'Incremental' game based on spirals and mathematics. Your goal is to make the spiral grow farther and farther from the origin. The game is very simple, but it is very deep and can be enjoyed for a long time!

row.name: Hacker Simulator: Free Trial
row.detailed_description: Important note about this Trial version This version of Hacker Simulator is a trial version and will give you access to the tutorial and the first contracts. To access the rest of the content, please go to the full version available here: Important note: Please note that Hacker Simulator is not a realistic 1:1 hacking simulation and that the mechanics are only inspired by real-life hacking methods. With Hacker Simulator , I wanted to bring a fun and immersive experience on the theme of hacking so that you can have a better vision of some of its aspects (being alone, I certainly can't cover all of them). In order to keep your business running, you need to stay anonymous regularly by hiding behind various wifi networks. To do this, you will learn how to use the famous suite of tools called Aircrack-ng ! A lot of research has been done to bring you a simplified and enjoyable version of real-life hacking methods such as bruteforce , exploits , phishing and more! You will learn a lot during your adventure, but you will also learn that hacking is not without risk. The networks you will explore will be secured and the wifi connections will be monitored , requiring a high level of attention.
row.short_description: Become a hacker and build your online reputation to the top by discovering a simplified and enjoyable version of real-life hacking methods. Complete contracts, buy new programs, upgrade your computer, crack wifi networks and infiltrate peoples or companies online systems.

row.name: Umille
row.detailed_description: Basta che un gioco sia difficile o che ci sia la possibilità di rotolare per farlo etichettare come souls-like, noi la pensiamo diversamente. Per noi la caratteristica più importante di un souls like deve essere quella di saperti imprimere una storia nella mente senza raccontartela. Umille vuole fare proprio questo, ovvero raccontarti una storia velata e interpretabile, in poche righe di dialogo, sfruttando l'ambiente e le descrizioni degli oggetti. La Storia Sei un avventuriero che decidere di sottoporsi a un test per diventare idoneo a essere il prossimo Re di Umille. Se vuoi sapere il resto, giocaci! Rigiocabilità Il punto di forza di questo progetto è senz'altro la rigiocabilità, 4 finali diversi, svariate scelte da fare per ottenerli. Personalizzazione del personaggio E' possibile scegliere sesso e classe iniziale del personaggio, la classe iniziale serve solo a determinare l'equipaggiamento di partenza. Il combattimento Il combattimento è a turni ma abbiamo fatto del nostro meglio per diminuire i limiti parametrici. Se si impara la sequenza delle mosse nemiche è possibile vincere anche con statistiche inferiori. Libertà La mappa è piccola e puoi andare ad affrontare il boss finale appena inizi il gioco se fai le scelte giuste.
row.short_description: Un prototipo, un idea di quello che potrebbe essere un RPG classico con le meccaniche di un Souls-like. Questo gioco si concentra soprattutto sulla storia che viene narrata in poche righe di dialogo e sta al giocatore capire come stanno le cose...

row.name: Walk with the Living
row.detailed_description: Grief leads a swordswoman and a necromancer to raise an infamous knight from his grave. Follow the trio's intimate quest for vengeance and make choices that impact their relationships with one another and those they meet. -Enjoy beautiful sprite art and character illustrations. -Consider space and terrain in creative ways to survive fast-paced, player-phase-focused tactical battles. -Meet complex characters and form relationships, both platonic and romantic, between them to gain in-battle benefits. -Make choices that impact the narrative and the relationships between various characters. All choices have consequences, both positive and negative. -Replay and make different choices to discover dozens of secret endings and character epilogues. Weapons, items, and gold carry over with new game plus. -Characters die permanently, but there are always more stories to be told; when a character dies, new narrative branches, relationships, and recruitments become available. -Focus on narrative without worrying about battlefield character deaths in Story mode. -There's a cat! Rowan Raised from the dead against his will to bring vengeance against his former employer, he struggles to cope with existing among the living in a body that feels dead. Aoife An unwilling leader of a growing movement to exact justice on the mercenary company raiding villages of the countryside, she harbors doubts about whether her mission to avenge her sister has meaning in the wake of her sister’s death. Keir After achieving what seemed impossible by raising Rowan from the dead, he accompanies Aoife on her quest of vengeance while holding onto regrets about his late lover, Niall.
row.short_description: Walk with the Living is a queer strategy melodrama focused on character-driven storytelling and player choice.
row.reviews: “[The] realistic depiction of the pain these characters are holding makes it easy to want them to find some happiness. Unlike the ‘which one will I choose?’ dating sim mechanics of recent Fire Emblem games, in Walk with the Living you get to play cupid, gradually encouraging dispossessed and traumatized characters to open up to each other and (maybe) start to see their future together. . . Perhaps best of all, it's a believably hopeful story about queer people.” Gamers with Glasses

row.name: Super Life: Franchise Lord
row.detailed_description: Super Life Franchise Lord is an incremental franchise management sim set in the world of Super Life RPG with an idle game progression system. Disclaimer: This game was designed for mobile devices and is best experienced on Android or iOS 1. Little Zeus 2. Slimmy Sam's 3. Taco Box 4. Angus McBangus Not actual gameplay. Start small and grow by upgrading equipment and researching new menu items to increase profitability! Complete customer orders yourself or hire employees and make them do all the work. They will still look to you to deal with customer complaints and handle workplace accidents. Purchase employee perks to hire better employees, increase employee levels to allow you to run your franchises more hands off. Raise animals for slaughter at the farm, or buy fresh ingredients from vendors at the farmers market! Buy (or steal) AmaZone boxes to collect items that help keep your franchises running smoothly or sway conversations in your favor. The Money Tree is back and serves as one of multiple daily reward systems in the game. You can also collect free coins from your coin miner and complete daily tasks for additional rewards!
row.short_description: Can you really take over the world with a sandwich? Short answer... MONEY IS EVIL!

row.name: Ghoul Dungeon
row.detailed_description: Ghoul Dungeon is a level-based adventure. As you make your way, you will encounter monsters you must fight off. You'll only be able to hit them up close, so make use of the ability to dash in order to avoid getting hit. In addition, you will be able to use power slashes to deal additional damage. Make sure you're aware of your cooldowns! You'll also encounter capsules to to heal you or provide attack boosts. Make use of these to power through! Note: Ghoul Dungeon was a personal project I made in high school, when I was still learning game dev, and I'm no longer working on the game. Still, I hope you guys enjoy it! Current number of levels available: 4 Additional notes: - Ghoul Dungeon is playable with a controller, however this is implemented only for experimental purposes (suggested method to play is with keyboard and mouse) - Currently, enemies can only attack at a close range  however in a future update a ranged variant will be added
row.short_description: Welcome to Ghoul Dungeon, a level-based adventure. As you make your way, you will encounter monsters you must fight off. You'll only be able to hit them up close, so make sure you stay agile.

row.name: Childlike(차일드라이크)
row.detailed_description: 'Childlike' is a journey to follow the innocence of childhood. Play as the child facing adventurous moments, the player should think like a child to overcome fear and obstacles ahead. In the kids' imagination, kids encounter many obstacles anywhere around the house, and outside, and of course, the school. They think of floor and road as things they must not step on, otherwise, they think they're gonna fall down. And their school becomes the scariest place at night and dolls are alive, move around. As a puzzle genre game, players need various abilities to move next. Comprehension of the game - Players should look around to find items, and think about what to do to deal with the obstacles. They can grab and throw, step on the objects not to step on the floor, just like 'The floor is lava'. Being alert - Players should always be careful and check if their footsteps or turning on the lights make any attraction to villains. If they find the players, something terrible will happen. And it will make the players not let their hair down. Rapid reaction - Players should concentrate on what is chasing them and how to deal with it quickly to survive. If they act late, there is no next. Through this game, the player can recall innocent minds as a child. *There are some English interfaces but all of the subtitles are Korean.
row.short_description: Use objects not to step on the floor. Do not step on the road outside. Run away from the Guard at school. Run away from the haunted doll.

row.name: 幻想枝魂 Soul Fantasy
row.detailed_description: This work is an A-SOUL's secondary creation of the same work. Plot Outline Red sky, flames ruthlessly devour everything in front of us. A huge white body leads an army like a wave to crush all good things. Some say it is God's depication; some say it is the embodiment of hell; none of the forces that try to resist it can fall well. Over time, people gave up resistance, it ruled the Zhijiang River, the reign of the Magic King let people shudder. No one dared to resist the mighty demons until the presence of the five girls broke the deadlock. And our story, from the first hundred years of the reign of the Demon King of Zhijiang... Game Introduction This game is an A-SOUL peer-to-RPG fantasy pixel game. The mechanism used in this game is round warfare. The game has multiple story branch selections, and your choices will change the direction of follow-up tasks, NPC communication, and plot direction. In the game, you can unlock a variety of CG, music. In the game, we have set up a lot of hidden collectibles, waiting for your discovery and exploration. In the game, you will not encounter meaningless queer tasks, and there will be no repetition of the branch plot without story content. Players can play without barriers even if they don't know A-SOUL. This story is pure fiction, the game background is the overhead world, and the real world of anyone, things, things have nothing to do with, if there is the same, is purely coincidental.
row.short_description: The white colossus fell from the sky, and the Demon Led Countless Demons to destroy all good things. For the future of the planet, for the belief in their hearts, five girls from different places, with different identities gathered together, embarked on the road to the demon king.
row.notes: PS: Some monster designs may cause discomfort to the player.

row.name: Tavern Crawl
row.detailed_description: Tavern Crawl is a student-made, 3rd-person adventure starring Fish, a young countryside mouse who dreams of adventure. His kingdom uses alcohol collected from the city they live below as currency, fuel for fires, and resources to craft delicious and useful cocktails. When the alcohol mysteriously dries up, Fish volunteers to leave his home and investigate where the precious resource has gone. Fast Paced Combat Use your needle sword and bottlecap shield to fight those that would keep you from your destiny. Crafting Cocktails Use the alcohol collected from fallen enemies to craft cocktails with all sorts of useful effects. Explore the Sewers Explore the rich world of the sewers, filled with a host of characters and secrets for you to discover.
row.short_description: Tavern Crawl is an alcohol-fueled adventure starring Fish, a young mouse on a quest to save his kingdom’s supply of booze from a gang of thieving rats through combat and crafting cocktails.
row.notes: Alcohol-related themes Fantasy violence

row.name: Kandra The Moonwalker
row.detailed_description: Kandra: The Moonwalker is a 3D platformer demo inspired by the great classics of Nintendo 64 and PlayStation like Spyro or Banjo Kazooie. In Kandra's universe the other Moonwalkers have disappeared and with them the magic has diseppeared. Kandra 's goal as one of the last remaining Moonwalkers is to find her friends and recover the magic feathers. Find collectibles! Collect feathers , gems and other collectibles to unlock abilities, open portals and progress towards your goal: collecting all the magic feathers and returning magic to the world. Defeat enemies and bosses! Fight against enemies that want to block your waym, from mere minions to bosses . Use different skills for different combat situations. Get new skills for Kandra! Unlock new skills to face enemies in new ways and overcome environmental challenges . Explore the different worlds and bring back the magic! Explore worlds, help their inhabitants , beat the bad guys and collect gems and feathers to restore order. Do you want to learn to create videogames like Kandra the Moonwalker? Use our link to access our free course and create your first 3D game in Unity today
row.short_description: Kandra The Moonwalker is a 3D platformer demo inspired by the great classics of N64 and PlayStation. Find collectibles, explore different worlds, unlock habilities, and return magic to the world by recovering the magic feathers.

row.name: Scrolls of Sengoku Dynasty
row.detailed_description: Sengoku Dynasty About the Software Welcome to feudal Japan! To pass the time until the release of Sengoku Dynasty, the scrolls will tell you everything you need to know before you start your fight for your legacy in the eagerly anticipated mixture of roleplaying game, city-builder and survival set against the stunning backdrop of Japan’s Sengoku era. Exclusive information straight from the development team will give you a chance to go behind-the-scenes. Plus: The interactive magazine is packed with meticulously researched articles, giving you an insight into Japan’s history, myths and facts and how it is woven into every fabric of the game world. As owner of all eight issues you will receive a loyalty bonus of 20% rebate on your purchase of Sengoku Dynasty (*). The scrolls are more than just a magazine. They are an experience! The official interactive magazine Development insights and background stories Glossary with hundreds of terms and explanations Developed in collaboration with Japanologists Rebate offer on the purchase of Sengoku Dynasty on Steam (*) First issue free-of-charge (*) available for a limited time period after launch
row.short_description: You can’t get any closer to Sengoku Dynasty. With the scrolls you’ll receive first-hand development infos as well as exciting background stories. Eight issues tell you everything you need to know about Sengoku Dynasty.

row.name: Sigh of the Abyss: Shadow Bonds ▪ Prologue
row.detailed_description: Shadow Bonds is an introduction to the world and characters of Sigh of the Abyss . You have been chained to a stranger, a boy foolish—or brave—enough to flee the gilded cage where magi are kept docile and pliant. The curse will kill you both unless you find a way to break it. Anyone else would already be dead, but not you—for you hear the ancient voice of the Abyss, and have been blessed—or cursed—with powers dark and terrible. Did the Abyss bestow upon you supernatural strength and agility? Do you have the power to manipulate the shadows and see what they see? Perhaps your dark gift is prying open the minds of others only to break them and have them do your bidding. Embrace your emotions. The four humors color the tone of your responses and your personality: will you be the carefree sanguine , the thoughtful phlegmatic , the anxious melancholic or the fiery choleric ? Will you stay friends or seek something more? Learn more about your companions, see how they react to the curse placed upon you, accept or reject their aid. Shadow Bonds will give you a glimpse into the friendship and romance system of Sigh of the Abyss . An introduction to the characters and setting of Sigh of the Abyss Customize the protagonist's name and skills A branching narrative with hard choices and terrible consequences Three unique endings with several variations each Sample what the romance interests have to offer, or stay friends Learn more about the rich setting of Sigh of the Abyss through codex entries
row.short_description: Embrace the monster within to free yourself from a curse in this dark fantasy visual novel, an introduction to the characters and setting of Sigh of the Abyss.
row.notes: This game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work because of the following: murder, suicide, text-only descriptions of gore, blood on screen, implied nudity, sexual innuendos, coarse language, legal alcohol consumption.

row.name: Welcome To Your Immune System
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Your Immune System is an addictive arcade-style video game where you defend human cells from invading bacteria. Use all the weapons in your arsenal from macrophages, killer T cells, to cytokines and learn how these work in real life. WTYIS was created with advice from world-leading vaccine researchers. The game is based on the fun retro 2D arcade games of the past such as Asteroids and Space Invaders. You only need a mouse and a keyboard! Can you hold out before all of your cells are infected??? Who Is the Game For? The game is totally free and is fun and educational for people of all ages. They are specifically designed to engage 11 - 14-year-old students and designed as a tool for teachers, researchers, and parents looking for a fun way to engage young people with the topics of immunology, vaccines, and the history of science. You can play the game in five languages - English, Chinese, French, Spanish, Hindi, and Portuguese. row.name: ScreenPlay CCG
row.detailed_description: A comedy-fueled collectible card game where movie tropes come to life—and run the studio too. ScreenPlay CCG is a digital card game set in a delightfully absurd universe where the characters from your favorite genres aren’t just starring in films—they’re the ones calling the shots. Literally. These eccentric directors produce, direct, and even sabotage each other’s blockbusters in the most chaotic filmmaking process ever committed to cardboard… or, well, digital cardboard. Build decks using genre-savvy characters, absurd plot twists, and iconic film tropes to outwit your rivals in a game that rewards strategy, timing, and a healthy appreciation for how ridiculous cinema can be. 🎞 CCG Meets Fighting Game Strategy Outthink, outplay, out-direct. Unlike traditional CCGs that rely on slow turns and predictable patterns, ScreenPlay borrows from fighting game mechanics. You and your opponent plan your moves at the same time, then watch the result unfold like you’re watching a classic masterpiece in the making. Whether you’re pulling off a perfect dodge, reading an attack two scenes ahead, or throwing down a plot twist that makes everything go off the rails, victory comes from reading your opponent as much as your deck. Want to bluff your way through a thriller? Go full ham in a melodrama? You can do that. This is a game of mind games and movie magic. ⏱ Simultaneous Turns No waiting, no stalling—just pure, unpredictable chaos. In ScreenPlay , both players secretly script their scenes (i.e., their turns) in advance. Once you've locked in your decisions, the game cuts straight to the action, playing both turns out simultaneously. The result? A fast-paced, brainy experience where timing and prediction are everything—and there's no room to pause for popcorn. Every scene is a gamble. Did your Horror Lead strike when your opponent adventurously dodged? Did they perform a dramatic scene while you expected an action movie-style assault? You won’t know until the camera rolls. 🏆 Win by Telling a Better Story Victory isn’t about HP bars—it’s about completing your character arcs . Every Lead character has a distinct narrative journey. Over the course of a match, you’ll earn Narrative Points by playing synergistic cards and making smart choices. Complete the arcs of any two of your three Leads, and you win the game. No explosions required—though those help too. This mechanic rewards clever deck construction, genre mastery, and good ol’ fashioned timing. It’s a game of stories within a story, where every match feels like a mini movie—even if the script makes no sense and half the cast is mysteriously missing in act two. Just remember: knowing your opponent’s Leads and their story goals can help you sabotage their arcs before they reach their big finale. 🎭 Lead the Cast with Genre-Bending Characters With over 22 unique Leads available at launch and many more in development, ScreenPlay is packed with genre-hopping personalities ready for the spotlight. Each Lead comes from a different cinematic tradition and brings a signature set of abilities and cards. Whether you're leaning into the brooding mystery of Richard Spade, the razor-sharp wit of Roast Comic Frog, the righteous vengeance of Maximus, or the pure chaos of the Illuminati Lizard, every character changes how you build your deck and approach the game. And with the ability to mix and match any three Leads, the combinations are practically limitless—well, not actually limitless, this is still an indie game. But you get the idea. 📚 Every Game is Its Own Movie Deckbuilding isn't just strategy—it's screenwriting. You’ll start each game by choosing three Leads and constructing a 40-card deck tailored to their unique arcs. Some cards represent their strengths. Others exploit genre clichés or set up over-the-top payoffs. Want to lean into a character’s Plot Armor? Go for it. Here, “lazy writing” is just another path to brilliance. The result is a game where every match feels like a short film that spirals out of control in the best possible way. Build tension. Subvert expectations. And maybe—just maybe—pull off a finale worthy of a standing ovation. 🎬 Solo Play for Aspiring Auteurs Not ready for the festival circuit? No problem. Start off with a guided tutorial and a pre-built deck to ease you into the chaotic world of ScreenPlay . Then, grow your collection by completing daily and weekly challenges, or by taking on boss bots in a rotating lineup of single-player game modes. There’s always something new to do—even if your cast is constantly forgetting their lines. Future updates will bring full-blown movie campaign modes, letting you explore the bizarre backstories, rivalries, and plot holes of your favorite Leads. Just pray they don’t go on strike before then. The devs writing the scripts themselves? Terrifying. 🌐 Multiplayer Mayhem Challenge filmmakers around the world in a battle for box office supremacy. Jump into competitive ladder matches against players of your skill level or explore alternate multiplayer formats for chaotic genre mashups. Want to make a romantic horror musical with a sci-fi twist and a noir detective lead? That’s not just possible—it’s encouraged . Show off your deckbuilding brilliance, master the meta, or just enjoy the ride. Because in ScreenPlay , even the worst movie can still win Best Picture if you play your cards right. Oh, and don’t forget to join the community on Discord—weekly tournaments, bonus prizes, and the occasional pun war await. 🧰 Craft Your Own Blockbuster Build your collection your way—whether through grind or glamour. Earn cards by completing missions, opening booster packs, or climbing the competitive ladder. Got extras? Use the in-game crafting system to recycle duplicates into the cards you actually want. Feeling like a silver spoon-fed producer? You can also buy cards directly. We get it—not everyone wants to hustle in the editing bay. No judgment (well, maybe a little). 🎬 Expansions, Sequels & Spin-Offs New content, every quarter. New drama, every time. Every three months, ScreenPlay gets a fresh injection of content—new Leads, new cards, new movies, and new ways to play. These expansions keep the meta fresh and the production mayhem rolling, giving you endless ways to reinvent your cinematic masterpieces. It’s like rebooting your favorite franchise, only on purpose. And with fewer angry fans. 🎤 Why ScreenPlay CCG Stands Out 🤺 Simultaneous turns for fast-paced, mind-game-rich strategy 🎭 Over 22 Lead characters across a wild spectrum of movie genres 📚 Story arc-based win conditions for narrative-driven gameplay 🧠 Deep deckbuilding with real strategic variety 🎮 Single-player and multiplayer modes with evolving content 😂 A comedic, self-aware tone that softens the sting of even the most dramatic defeats So—ready to make your directorial debut? ScreenPlay CCG is your all-access pass to a world where genres collide, characters clash, and every match is a chance to create the worst great movie ever made.

Krai. Digital-poetry vol. 1
row.detailed_description: The first collection of digital-poetry Krai. Created by variously gone-mad poets. 5 games. Curator: Ilia Mazo. 1. «Metaphysical Trolleybus Simulator». A parable about the path to a dream. The dream role belongs to a Mountain. You are a trolley. Rolling around the city through your trolley-life, you know. Passengers inside will get mad, if you get out of the way. But you will get out and get it. A dream. A Mountain. And then they will sing a song for the first time in their passenger life. A song about the journey and voices in our heads. 2. «A Silent Room» is an existential hokku. Don’t you go outside without a hat? Come in. Wellcome. A room. The room is always warm. It is funny, sad, calm, loud, and quiet inside. All your stuff is here, isn’t it? Sure, it is. It is your room. Time passes by, things go away and leave marks in your head. The more you remember, the less air you have. Have you ever seen this place, these walls before? You have already been here. Come inside. Lie down. It is silent. It is always silent. «The Flower» is a dating-madness simulator. A flower afflatus, post-modern and post-psycho poetry. After a long-long working day on a Plantation, you are in high spirits. Happy, right! Today is the day, today is the date with your lovely beloved. Your heart is burning, your breathing is rapid, the urban landscape around blooms in a euphoric frenzy of colors. Something makes you think better, feel better, see better, bloom better. But something is missing… Bouquet! It would be extremely unethical to show up for a date without a bunch of flowers. No problem, it has never been a problem for you. Look around. All you need is to pick a few flowers… «ORG» is a futuristic shoot-a-fable about the censor routine of the nearest future. Congratulations! You have just got a promotion. From now on you are responsible for the art transfer through CAD (Culture Assurance Department). Be careful, the cultural enrichment of our clients lies in your hands. The future is CAD. CAD is the Future. «Ticker» is a running-n-crying runner about the mind night, the utterance impossibility. Shortly before going to bed, you uprise a few words in front of your eyes and write them down on a piece of paper. You will try to remember the words’ order through falling asleep…the words…the order…ords…woder… Each pulsating beat of your sleepy mind brings you closer and closer to the non-verbalized world. There is nothing to say. Say no more. The night is still young, and you are on your way to the letter fugue.
row.short_description: KRAI. DIGITAL-POETRY VOL.1 The first collection of digital-poetry Krai. Created by variously gone-mad poets. 5 games. Curator: Ilia Mazo.

row.name: 做了个魔塔 Just made a MageTower
row.detailed_description: 关注我们： Bilibili：@万一游戏作坊WanyiGames QQ群:383534788 这是款由虚幻4（unreal4）引擎开发，保留了原本玩法的换皮魔塔。 在这里，你不用再上下左右进行缓慢爬行，我们为勇者加入了自动寻路的功能。 为了防止寻路的时候打到不想打的怪，你可以开启防误触模式选择是否进行战斗。 在这里，你不用再一遍遍的跑去找商人升级，我们把升级做成了随身携带的功能。 只要按U键或者是升级按钮，就可以一键进行升级。 在这里，你不用再为反复打开图鉴查询怪物信息而感到烦恼， 我们增加了怪物头顶的伤害显示功能，还增加了鼠标挪动查看具体图鉴的功能。 在这里，你不用再为存档数量发愁， 我们加入了65535个存档槽位，包你够用。 在这里，你也不用再为那些一言难尽的隐藏墙和隐藏道具查攻略， 我们承诺不加入任何影响游戏性的彩蛋。 最后，游戏中加入了大量的由虚幻引擎制作的视觉效果，应该会给你惊喜。 平心而论，魔塔，这个来自于二十多年前的老游戏并不复杂。 数值只有基础的攻防血量，计算模型是小学二年级水平的加减法，以及乘法。 决定路线选择的，钥匙和门的对应关系也只有三种， 游戏中所有的选择策略都可以被抽象为——先去打收益高的怪。 但是用这些最简单的要素，却能组合出一个大多数人都没法第一次就通关的游戏， 这里我斗胆代表一下大多数，起码我没有在第一次通关。 就像蛋炒饭一样，最简单又最难，这确实是一件值得游戏制作者挑战的事情。 做了个魔塔，欢迎大家体验游玩。 这也是我们工作室在Steam上架的第一款游戏，还请多多包含，也请期待后续更多的作品。
row.short_description: 由虚幻4引擎打造，还原经典魔塔体验。 免费游玩，你还在等什么！ 魔塔可以被视作一种固定数值的RPG游戏， 但它更应该是一种需要精密计算的策略游戏。 你需要认真的比对你与怪物的攻防相差， 以及每一步行动的先后次序。 一点小小的改变会导致后续巨大的差异。 请在游玩时谨慎存档，并尝试每一种可能。

This game is meant to be played through multiple times in order to test out the different rope lengths and discover certain secrets hidden within Lily's household. 10+ Main Endings 3+ Hidden Endings An Undisclosed Number of Puzzles 3+ Alternate Names for the Toilet Many things a child named Lily should not see While Lily's Well is completely free on all platforms, the Lily's Well Bonus Pack is available as DLC for those who wish to directly support the developer.
