row.name: MORE ENEMIES
row.detailed_description: More Enemies has been called the best video game of all time By who? No clue. But here at Lollygag Labs, we strive to be optimists in the face of adversity! Starting at a dead-end job for an obscure paper company with no story relevance, you venture onto your next job as an employee at... Lollygag Labs. A game development company with questionable ethics! Where you uncover a plot of spoilers, deviance, gore, dangerous chairs, and of course: enemies MORE ENEMIES is a single-player first-person shooter and exploration game with exciting weapons, interactable characters, and plenty of exciting environments from offices to secret bases in a story-driven campaign where you have to try to survive glowing cubes to being exterminated to getting eaten by giant mutated monsters! Bringing on fantastic new voice talent and all that other good sh*t, MORE ENEMIES will truly have you falling backward in your gaming chair!
row.short_description: Put on your ass-kicking socks and get ready to have them promptly blown off in this indie monster-killing-bad-guy-fleeing-vent-crawling-chair-wielding shooter!
row.notes: MORE ENEMIES has mature language (multiple f-bombs, sh*ts, and more) and gore (blood and 'chunks' when shooting enemies)

row.name: Umbra Galaxy
row.detailed_description: Description Umbra Galaxy is a 2D space shoot'em'up inspired by the old classics like Kobo and.. Kobo Deluxe? Yeah, that's about it. Anyways, you fly your spaceship, you shoot enemies, the enemies blow up! If the enemies hit you — you blow up. It's as simple as that! The only question now is what are you waiting for? Launch it up! Features 15 unique levels 2 kinda different bosses Powerups here and there to spice up the experience! 16 achievements cause everybody loves achievements! The complete lack of any sort of lore or story! Leaderboards! No price on this bad boy!
row.short_description: Umbra Galaxy is a sci-fi shoot'em'up where you pilot a spaceship adrift in the restricted space filled with enemies. Destroy enemy generators, fight your way to the bosses and secure the obscure goal in the end!

row.name: Warsaw: Paris of the North (prototype)
row.detailed_description: New York, 1935... James, a middle-aged millionaire, decides to go on a business journey to Warsaw, to prove that making money is possible anywhere. Soon it turns out that this trip is not only to make his point but also to change his life. James takes part in plenty of adventures such as a two weeks cruise by one of the first polish transatlantic ships, tasting Warsaw cuisine, going on the ball at which he meets people from Warsaw's Boheme, and is chased by a car with the most dangerous criminals in the capital of Poland... At some point, after tons of adventures, spine-chilling events, meeting two incredible women, he falls in love with Warsaw and making money is not his life goal anymore. He starts doing everything to protect his new friends and the city before the upcoming war. There are two possibilities that can help him achieve his goal. Become a philanthropist and help to change Warsaw into the intellectual capital of Europe or become a film producer, and let the motion pictures change the world. Which choice is better? Will James succeed or will he give up? GAME FEATURES: 📜 plenty of original archival materials (videos, photos), 📜 developing main heroes character with two indicators: bravery and diplomacy, 📜 epilogues from other perspectives after every stage, 📜 sketches after every stage which present the path which was chosen by the player, 📜 over diversified 20 quests, 📜 two big main paths: film producer plot and the philanthropist. This is a prototype of the game Warsaw: Paris of the North. The development of the game's prototype has been financed from the resources of the Culture Promotion Fund of Ministry of Culture National Heritage and Sport of the Republic of Poland.
row.short_description: Warsaw: Paris of the North is a Choose Your Own Adventure Game, built on text, graphics with plenty of choices that develop the main character’s features and direct him to a variety of plots. Set in 1930’s Warsaw.

row.name: Meow Express
row.detailed_description: You are a cat on a robot vacuum cleaner. Which means you are bus driver in the cat world! Dodge obstacles, pop innocent kids' baloons, dash through buildings to collect your fellow cat pussengers and deliver them to the promised pillow land! - Hover around the course - Dash through obstacles - Upgrade your flying robot vacuum cleaner - Collect different cat pussengers - Like literally, collect your pussengers Meow Express is a jam-game made within a couple of days. It has memes, smol easter eggs, engaging and enraging gameplay, hand drawn art, meowy melodies, pun-full cat city names and more!
row.short_description: You are a cat on a robot vacuum cleaner. Which means you are bus driver in the cat world! Dodge obstacles, pop innocent kids' baloons, dash through buildings to collect your fellow cat pussengers. Meow Express is a cute, fun and annoying casual arcade game, just like our furry friends.

row.name: The Augury House
row.detailed_description: The Augury House is a living house filled with strange secrets and dream-like spaces. Take your time in exploring the many spaces of The Augury House, which shift every other week! Manuals are your Guide! Please read our Manual for controls, hints, and basic information about this project. The Manual will expand as new things are added to the house! For a compilation of all of the secrets of The Augury House, please read our Quick Reference Guide (aka DevHandbook)! Mystery of the Frog Let your ears guide you towards the frogs that live within the house's walls. If you are patient enough, they might let you into their deep and dark cave. Features - HUD-less design - Hidden spaces - Spatial audio - Virtual Exhibitions
row.short_description: The Augury House is a shifting collection of short experiences and exhibitions. Contents change weekly.

row.name: The Vortex
row.detailed_description: The Vortex is intended to be the safest and most elegantly designed audio discussion space in the metaverse and beyond. Every vortex room is facilitated by a robotic laser facilitator that operates the discussion circle. Visitors to any vortex room will see a circle of stones in the center where they can sit if they wish to participate in the discussion rounds. Participants are each given an equal amount of time to speak and they can pass without speaking or whenever they are finished. The microphone rotates automatically, so no human needs to “warn” or “facilitate” people if their time is almost up. All vortex circles have 12 stones for up to 12 active participants. Additional people can be in the room as audience members. Audience members can press a button to get in line for the next available open stone. Users may create their own vortex rooms where they can change the amount of time per person to speak. The creator of every room has the ability to pin and change messages such as topics on a virtual display board in the room if they wish.
row.short_description: The Vortex, a metaverse connected social environment where all are welcome. The facilitation system ensures all people have an equal opportunity to speak.

row.name: Ampguard
row.detailed_description: 50 students of the study program Media Informatics and Interactive Entertainment at the University of Applied Sciences Mittweida have developed their own game within 11 months - Ampguard. When light and darkness split the earth - everything chooses a side.While yokai and animals have always endured in the darkened forests, humans with their spirit birds remained in the safety of the towns. They intended to keep the balance between the scales of harmony. But time weakens the link between humans and spirit birds. A yearly festival of light shall strengthen their bonds. During the celebration, a defender of the light who shall carry the title of 'ampguard' is chosen. His mighty armour strengthens the bond between the wearer and his spirit bird. It becomes their burdon to shield the festivities from the advancing corruption of the dark. When the festival buzzes proudly, the troops of night come creeping from the forest's depths to drown the festival's radiance. Only the ampguard is the ray of hope within the last stand against the darkness. Ampguard is an action-packed rogue-like single player experience with an adaptable combat system and strategic gameplay elements. Fight with powerful abilities: Collect Shards, which you combine with Talismans to unlock new abilities and combat patterns, and defeat an eerie collection of creatures! Every misstep is punished, but victory is all the sweeter. Talismans strengthen you and your Shards. Gain an advantage by cleverly combining them. Discover your strategy: The unique combat system offers you a variety of combinations to assign to your shards. Personalize the moveset of your ampguard and win the battle! Improve yourself constantly: New dangers await you in every zone. Take on new challenges and benefit from their advantages. Combine and upgrade your shards at the workbench to be ready for the next battle. A dark and magical forest: venture into the mysterious forest and restore balance. Explore a world full of sinister Yokai monsters just waiting for your visit. Rest in the rest zones and gather new strength for battle. Reach the end and encounter the unpredictable.
row.short_description: Ampguard is a rogue-like game with a unique combat system and nasty monsters. Combine your skills and use them in the best possible way to emerge victorious from the battle against the Yokai.

row.name: Game Dev Arcade
row.detailed_description: Game Dev Arcade is a collection of basic arcade games from a variety of genres ranging from top down shooters to platformers. They all feature individual leaderboards and Steam Achievements. Mars Madness - OUT NOW You are dropped on Mars with one objective - to kill all aliens! In this top down shooter, run across the Mars landscape eliminating all threats. How long can you survive?? Monstrous Maze - OUT NOW You have been taken down to the Ghoul's basement to be served for dinner. Can you escape the maze and return home? Level up your evasion skills as you continue to escape. Crystal Corridors - OUT NOW A platformer where you control a Marble and try to collect all of the crystals before making it to the end of the level! Don't move too fast, or you may just fall off the edge. Learn Game Dev!! These games were developed by Valthazier from Bulwark Creative. They were made to help show how simple video games are created, and there are many videos about the development of these games on Bulwark Creative's social media profiles. Full source code of the games can also be downloaded to view in the Unreal Engine 5.0 Editor. Credits Many game ideas were created by GameDev.tv and most assets used are courtesy of Epic Game's Unreal Engine store.
row.short_description: Game Dev Arcade is a collection of indie arcade games developed by Bulwark Creative. The source code will be available so you can see how they were developed! Play the games yourself, and then check out all the nitty gritty details that go in to making simple video games.

row.name: Axiallis
row.detailed_description: Don’t let the look of this game deceive you, it might look similar to Tetris, but it doesn’t play like Tetris. The goal is to overlap the piece’s pivot segments on top of each other and stack as many pieces as you can on the play field. Train your brain in pattern recognition, develop good strategies than practice to play faster. Everything you do whilst playing is analyzed; the quality of your play style and everything related to your reaction time and play speed. When you complete a game, the taunting AI will judge your performance and comment on it. It might give you advices, encouragements or even laugh at you. Axiallis, like many puzzle game, is an excellent tool to keep your brain healthy and stimulated. The cyber sci-fi visual theme of the game is complemented by a soothing downtempo soundtrack composed by NeurAxis. Jonas Neubauer (April 19, 1981 – January 5, 2021) was an American Tetris player, seven-time champion at the Classic Tetris World Championship. He brought back, for many of us, a love for NES Tetris. But apart from that, he was an intelligent, funny and kind person that really had a special gift to make everyone feel appreciated and included. The Evonescent indie game studio was founded a few weeks after Jonas's passing and is entirely due to that tragic event. The name 'Evonescent' comes from evolution and evanescent, and for which the concept was' The Evolution of everything that fades away'. By making this game, we pay tribute to Jonas, whom we loved. We really hope that Axiallis will be able to play a small part in keeping the memory of Jonas Neubauer alive.
row.short_description: Tetris like sci-fi block puzzle game
row.notes: This game contains swear words and references to drugs

row.name: What Lies in the Multiverse - Prologue
row.detailed_description: What Lies in the Multiverse Prologue is the first chapter of one truly crazy adventure. Intended as an introduction to the world of What Lies in the Multiverse, this prologue will introduce you to the game’s dimension shifting mechanics, eccentric main characters, and the opening chapter of a story that's filled with laughs, gags, and a bit of the macabre. This prologue is approximately 1 hour of playing time. What Lies in the Multiverse is a story-driven, puzzle platform adventure that one could call a dramatic comedy. Filled to the brim with hilarious, cartoonish hijinks, the narrative also presents the player with mature and deep themes like death, envy, and obsession. Things inevitably go batshit crazy very fast in the Multiverse when you discover the ability to travel between parallel worlds. These worlds are alternate versions of each level and differ in aesthetic, theme, and physicality. Switching between them allows you to solve logical and spatial challenges and to progress the story. Seamless Transformations Would you like to change the game world on the fly? Now you can! Can't reach a ledge? Bam! Switch worlds mid-air. Afraid of sliding around in an icy environment? Alternate to another universe for firmer ground! Just be careful when messing with gravity... Diverse World Embark on a journey across a variety of gorgeous pixel-art worlds, each offering something unique. Explore temples, towns, harbors, the wilderness and more as you race to unlock the secrets of the Multiverse. Colorful Cast of Characters Meet a bunch of quirky but compelling characters such as Everett, your eventual genius companion. Picture a sarcastic, eccentric Albert Einstein. Then there’s EZ, a mysterious figure everyone fondly remembers but can't describe. Or ZENITH, a group of enigmatic and shadowy figures always breathing down your neck. A Deeper Story While staying true to its light-hearted nature, the story's poignancy builds as you progress. A rollercoaster of laughter, joy, and sorrow awaits.
row.short_description: Experience the first hour What Lies in The Multiverse. A bombastic puzzle platformer about worlds turned inside out. Shift dimensions at the push of a button, solve brain-twisting logistical riddles, and race through the wilds of the multiverse in a bleakly & hilarious story.
row.notes: What Lies in the Multiverse contains strong language, violence.

row.name: Yoshitaka Amano VR Museum
row.detailed_description: The 'Amano Yoshitaka VR Museum' is an extraordinary art gallery that brings to life the masterpieces created by Amano Yoshitaka in a virtual space, showcasing his works like never before! Experience those renowned artworks dancing, leaping off the canvas, and most importantly, immerse yourself within their captivating world! Harnessing cutting-edge technology, we have transformed the boundless imagination derived from Amano Yoshitaka's creations into a virtual reality of the utmost brilliance. In the 'Yoshitaka Amano VR Museum', each exhibition area including the first wave of girls'exhibition and future updates is charged independently. You can make a small payment for the specific exhibition you are interested in; if you have not yet paid, you can Tour the halls of the VR Museum and learn about Yoshitaka Amano's chronicles. Please relax in the fantastic art world drawn by Yoshitaka Amano. It's also nice to be misguided by colorful pop girls at the girl's exhibition after paying. Why not embark on this entirely new art appreciation journey and be part of it yourself? Join us and experience the thrill of this extraordinary artistic adventure!
row.short_description: 'I love Mr.Amano's work!' Now you can watch them closer, marvel at the brush and lively moves! The space is designed to match each area, and more independent fee areas will be released, you can pay and watch what you want. If you haven't paid, you can still watch Mr.Amano's story in the lobby.

row.name: AGAINST Beatmap Editor
row.detailed_description: Discord server for mapping/modding discussions About the Software Against Beatmap Editor is a free tool that allows you to create your own maps using your own music. Using this editor you can place enemies, weapons and obstacles in perfect synchronization with your music. Then you can play your custom maps in AGAINST. Features: • Upload a song, then place weapons, enemies, and obstacles • Synchronize all the player actions to the beat • Select different environment or create your own • Test your maps in VR without leaving the editor • Drag and drop obstacles to the timeline • Copy and paste notes or sections • Customizable camera views • Bookmarks • Hotkeys • And more.... Bring your creative ideas to life!
row.short_description: Against Beatmap Editor is a free tool that allows you to create your own maps using your own music. Using this editor you can place enemies, weapons and obstacles in perfect synchronization with your music. Then you can play your custom maps in AGAINST.

row.name: Fireflies & Figments: A Willow's Journey
row.detailed_description: Adventure is better together! Using the buddy system, take control of two young adventurers as they journey deep into a mysterious forest full of fear and wonder, retracing the steps of teacher and KIN Willows founder, Hazel Willow, who disappeared over a century ago. Since her disappearance, her story has become legend, inspiring a generation to find their “KIN,” an acronym she coined for the guiding principles of Knowledge, Imagination, and Nature. Seemingly led by the light of the fireflies and opposed by the dark figments of the forest, the KIN Willows will need your help to test their skills, earn badges, and ultimately face their greatest fears to unlock the mysteries of the forest and solve the disappearance of Hazel Willow. Fireflies & Figments: A Willow’s Journey is a 3rd person, top-down, adventure game where you take control of both characters in a single player co-op experience as you solve puzzles, earn badges for new skills, and explore a mysterious forest where your imagination brings fear and wonder to life! This is a fully-playable vertical slice game featuring Willow’s Rest, The Bramblewoods, Perry’s Cave, and the Blizzcrag! Key Features: Imagination Meter - Harnessing the power of the Imagination Meter will require balancing your fear and wonder to control the unexpected effects of imagination on your journey. Buddy System - It's not safe to go alone. Take control of two characters at once and work together to face your greatest fears and solve the mystery of the disappearance of Hazel Willow. KIN Badges - Earn KIN Badges by overcoming obstacles and mastering unexpected challenges to unlock new skills and become the adventurer you were meant to be! Additional Gameplay Details: Single player Dynamic top-down 3rd person camera with zoom in and out based on distance of characters Dynamic visuals and gameplay triggered by Imagination meter, including combat and puzzle hints Unlock new skills through cooperative puzzle solving and exploration Light combat and platforming elements
row.short_description: Adventure is better together! Using the buddy system, take control of two young adventurers as they journey deep into a mysterious forest full of fear and wonder, retracing the steps of teacher and KIN Willows founder, Hazel Willow, who disappeared over a century ago.

row.name: Forbidden Fruit
row.detailed_description: About This Game Are you an adventurer? Do you like exotic places? If so grab your things and jump on the plane with Maya and Leo to visit the secret island in the heart of the ocean! A mysterious land that can’t be found on any of the maps awaits you. Explore wild jungles and beautiful forests, meet the islanders and make new friends. Find treasures, solve puzzles and discover new secrets of the island. Will the brother and sister return to their busy city or will they stay on the island and make this place their new home? Let's find out. “Forbidden fruit” is a nonlinear hentai visual novel with quest elements. You decide what path your character takes. Control their emotions and feelings with the Lust\Chastity system. Immerse yourself into the new world. Find new items and weapons to destroy your enemies with. But before you face the danger in different dungeons you must help the islanders and do some quests for them and make the bonds of friendship. This is the only way to create the party that will fight monsters beside you in your exciting journey. Awaiting You In the Game Is ✔ A Pleasant Light and Relaxing Adventure. ✔ Dozens Of Furrys Of All Types ✔ Support for a variety of fetishes, high-quality illustrations, and animated adult content. ✔ An easy but interesting combat system. ✔ An assortment of minigames. ✔ Original relaxing music to enhance your exotic experiences. We invite all of you to dive into a thrilling fantasy world that will bewitch your heart and mind! “Warning! This game contains scenes of erotic nature.”
row.short_description: This is a story about brother and sister seeking their missing father on a mysterious island. Adventure awaits you in tropical lands full of secrets! You’ll make new friends, learn new things and battle many different enemies. Forbidden island is waiting for you.
row.notes: This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: Nudity or Sexual Content, General Mature Content, instances of extreme sexual themes such as non-consensual sex, BDSM, and sexual violence.

row.name: Colony Simulator
row.detailed_description: Can your Colony survive 10 days or more in the desert? Find food, build your colony, recruit new workers, feed your population, craft tools and equipment, cook food and research technologies! Colony Simulator is a Template for the Unity Game Engine. This is just a preview of that asset, so not a full game in itself. Gameplay: -Player controls (mouse and keyboard). -Building and Crafting -Resource gathering -Inventory system -Selection system -Automated colonist work schedules -Equipment -Character attributes (health, hunger, happiness...) -Attacking and HP -Factories for item production. -Resources regeneration -Tech Tree -Event system -Game clock, day/night cycle -Save/Load system
row.short_description: Can your Colony survive 10 days or more in the desert? Find food, build your colony, recruit new workers, feed your population, craft tools and equipment, cook food and research technologies!

row.name: Polygunners
row.detailed_description: Polygunners is a cooperative bullet hell game where you and your friends team up to battle evil shapes! As you battle your way through the world, you will unlock better gear and abilities to use against your foes. When you think you're ready, buckle up and take on The Polyqueen, the source of all evil in this land. IMPORTANT NOTE: Polygunners supports Steam Remote-Play, meaning you can play with others over the internet. Simply launch the game, then invite one of your friends to join your instance of the game using the shift-tab menu. The core gameplay is a ability-based twin-stick shooter. You and your party journeys through towns, dungeons, and boss rooms as you find new abilities and gear by defeating enemies and purchasing items from shops. With over 100 items to be collected, you're able to gather the upgrades that fits your playstyle. Each player can make a build that feels right for them. Solo play is supported, but groups of up to four can team up with local-coop and fight through the dungeons as a squad. Playing as a team adds new abilities and mechanical potential to the already exciting gameplay. Do you have what it takes to kill The Polyqueen?
row.short_description: Polygunners is a cross between a twin-stick shooter and an RPG. Upgrade abilities, explore dungeons and towns, and fight bosses to progress through the world. Playing with your friends with local co-op cranks the experience up to 11 for satisfying dynamic gameplay.

row.name: Deliver or Die!
row.detailed_description: Deliver or Die! is an arcade game based on many classic ideas put together. With a bomb strapped to your car, time is of the essence. Collect deliveries, drop them off, and make sure they are on time... or you DIE! Compete for first place! Do you have what it takes to be the best delivery driver? Prove you're worthy and show it to the entire world on the Steam Leaderboard! At the end of each run (if highscore) your score gets placed on the leaderboard. And if it's high enough, you may even take first place... Classic Arcade Gameplay! Deliver or Die! has a very retro feeling set of core mechanics to bring you back to a much simpler time. This includes powerups, gameplay that gets much harder the farther you get, and of course, drifting! Vehicle Customization! Deliver or Die! has a progression based cosmetic system. The higher the score you get, the better the skins you get. And, skins are the ultimate flex... And remember, you must...
row.short_description: Deliver or Die! is an arcade game based on many classic ideas put together. With a bomb strapped to your car, time is of the essence. Collect deliveries, collect powerups, drop off the deliveries, and make sure they are on time... or you DIE!

row.name: Nociception ~ Voltaic Marketplace
row.detailed_description: (WARNING: Game contains bright colors and flashy graphics. Full screen recommended if you are experiencing lag in windowed mode ) “The Miracle” is an event that happened 500 years ago on the planet Commotion. It marks the day that the dead began coming back from their graves in strange new forms, and the knowledge of where people go when they die was no longer a mystery. Turns out people have become much too complex to send to either just heaven or hell when they die, so it was revealed that you will take a certain “death route” depending on how you lived and died. The Miracle Festival celebrates this special day and the beauty of the cycle of life and death. It happens all over the planet but the festival in Mordimane, the planet's densest city, is said to be the grandest of them all. -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Here it is!! My biggest project Ive ever done. I hope you enjoy my funny world of ghosts and bullets. A game by Ethereal Airport Featuring music by Pengosolvent and Princess Sylvysprit
row.short_description: A fantasy bullet hell on a strange, familiar planet. Fight the living and the dead as you figure out what's causing all this energy in the air! Play as a troupe of living puppets, curious immortal children, or a demon, and be sure to scan enemies to unlock journal pages on the way!

row.name: Bounce Trials
row.detailed_description: Play as a bouncing ball that never stops...bouncing! Your objective is simple: make your way through 30 levels as fast as you can, racing against the clock to earn Gold, Silver, and Bronze rewards. All you have to do is guide the ball left or right, timing your movements perfectly to get to that ledge, or onto that moving platform, or past those spikes, or land large gaps. Just watch you don't lose your 3 lives or you'll need to start the level again! It's a relaxing game that may test your patience as you have to wait for the ball to bounce high enough to make your next move. Get ready to hit 'Restart', it's your friend!
row.short_description: Patience and timing are key Bounce Trials, where you are a perptually bouncing ball that bounces through levels to reach a goal. Your only influence over the ball is to move either left or right. Compete against the clock and earn Gold, Silver, and Bronze rewards based on your completion time.

row.name: How Fish Is Made
row.detailed_description: You are a sardine in a machine, but is life that simple? This place imposes on you and your fellow fish a prophetic choice. Will you help them, or lead them astray? Will they do the same to you? Do Fish Feel Pain? HOW FISH IS MADE is a short narrative-driven experience about talking to fish and making choices. Live the ultimate power fantasy of being a sardine. Seek guidance from your fellow flounders. Ponder the vast sea of fishly existence. Flop around. Destiny is in the fold of your fin. Salmon All Your Courage Explore a wet and squalid world of sin and sardines. A place of fragrant mystery, the inhabitants of this place seek solace in the whirs, bops, and gentle slaps that echo through the halls. Though few can face the terrible choice all fish must make: UP or DOWN? But you’re no coward, are you? A Musical Epic Everyone needs a reprieve from the horrors of existence. Features the original song 'Little Lily Swing' by Tri-Tachyon Tired of Flopping? Try Rolling! Featuring the fantastic free katamari-like DLC, The Last One and Then Another. Absorb fleshy bits and your fellow fish in the noble quest to BECOME MASSIVE. Featuring a very special appearance from MOUTHWASHING’s very own Captain Curly! Feel Stuff! The sardines look just like the real thing, so you can really believe they have emotions. Guaranteed! WARNING! The game contains: - TRYPOPHOBIA inducing imagery. - Potentially disturbing subject matters. - Just a pinch of cum
row.short_description: Are sardines trustworthy? Are you? Do you want to be? How Fish is Made is a janky little jaunt through the world of surrealist storytelling. Now featuring a Katamari-like DLC!
row.notes: There is some graphic fish violence, trypophobia inducing imagery, and just a pinch of cum.

row.name: The Great Deer
row.detailed_description: What is The Great Deer? The Great Deer is a more modern style point-n-click adventure game where you play as an intrepid explorer searching for an artefact of great value. Discover and travel to ancient and long forgotten temple. Journey into the labyrinth of rooms that makes up the temple, discover the secrets within, and uncover the dark truth behind a sinister ritual taking place within its walls. Will you find what you’re searching for? Will you reach its inner chambers in time to stop the temples inhabitants from awakening their demon god? Buy the game now to find out! Art and Aesthetic The Great Deer has a hand drawn cartoon art style, with frame by frame animation. The game uses vector graphics to reach an infinite resolution, so the game will look crystal clear on all devices. The game also utilises a more flat digital art style during some portions to replicate the look of stained glass windows. This too is all vector, so the game looks great on any screen size! UI The Great Deer utilises a simple and clean UI design that both is easy to read, but also reflects the tone of the game. Use left, right, and down arrows on the edges of the screen to move around the temple. Use the inventory on the right of the screen to inspect and use items you find in the temple. Worried your inventory will fill up? Use the little arrow at the bottom to expand the inventory! Gameplay And Puzzles Discovering the secrets of the temple will not be so easy! Throughout the temple are many difficult puzzles that will withhold the way forward. With a wide variety of puzzles throughout the game, you’ll need to use your brain to find the clues and solve the puzzles to progress. You’ll also need to explore the temple. Within are many rooms and secret passageways, that offer a non-linear experience, often with more than one way to get around the temple. All combined, this game offers around 2-5 hours of gameplay. Story and Atmosphere The temple of The Great Deer has many secrets within. With a well fleshed out backstory, this game offers a narrative filled with environmental storytelling and the opportunity to uncover the secrets of the ritual taking place inside the temple. Soundtrack The Great Deer has a beautiful original soundtrack composed by Aliel Hernandez and Andres Ciambotti. Language support The Great Deer is officially supported in 3 languages: -English -Spanish -Kosraen (Kosraen translation is a little janky)
row.short_description: The Great Deer is a point-n-click adventure game where you play as an intrepid explorer searching for an artefact of great value. Journey into an ancient and long forgotten temple, discover the secrets within, and uncover the dark truth behind a sinister ritual taking place within its walls.

row.name: From Warrior to Hero (Idle 3D RPG) Playtest
Mot De Pass
row.detailed_description: Mot De Pass is a collective project of the course students. Each level of the game was created by Man during learning. After, we connected all the levels together. Before training, no developer was involved in creating games. The game was created and developed in 4 months. The main character chasing the Antagonist, but he manages to open a portal and enter the new world. Each world can be any: maybe fantasy city with magic or a post-apocalypse? The main character is hindered by the Antagonist's henchmen along the way. Also, sometimes the character needs to solve puzzles The player uses weapons to neutralize enemies. He can find it at the level, or secretly neutralize the enemy in order to get the first weapon. Often the locals of the levels call the character and tell where they saw the Antagonist and his minions. The main task of the main character is to catch up with the antagonist before he opens the next portal. Obstacles appear on the way of the main character, where it is necessary to use the parkour technique. Will the main character catch up the Antagonist?
row.short_description: The main character pursues the Antagonist, but he manages to open a portal and enter the world. The world can be different: whether it be a fantasy city with magic or a post-apocalypse

row.name: Vaccine Delivery Adventure
row.detailed_description: Vaccine Delivery Adventure is a classic side-scrolling action game where a healthcare worker has to overcome the challenges of delivering the BCG Vaccine to the communities that need it. As you deliver the vaccine in different locations you learn more and more about the BCG vaccine and the challenges of protecting communities against tuberculosis. Pay attention to your fellow health workers as you will be quizzed at the end. You can play the game in English, Chinese, Hindi, French, Spanish, and Portuguese. We will not collect any personal data: At the beginning of the game, we ask for the player to anonymously provide their age and country of origin along with a 3 letter nickname. This is so we can ensure that the games are reaching the right audience. We will not, and cannot, record individual personal/contact information in the game.
row.short_description: Vaccine Delivery Adventure is a classic side-scrolling action game where a healthcare worker has to overcome the challenges of delivering the BCG Vaccine to the communities that need it!

row.name: Mirror News Center
row.detailed_description: This is a free app for news about the Mirror Series and Promotions. You can learn about the newest information about our games and promotions here! row.name: Mr. Photographer
row.detailed_description: Embark on a vibrant journey through the lens of 'Mr. Photographer,' a captivating low-poly stylized family platformer game that challenges you to navigate through whimsical worlds, capturing the essence of adventure with every snapshot. As an aspiring photographer on the brink of turning your internship into a successful career, you'll leap, dash, and soar across platforms, collecting an array of photo cameras and SD cards to compile your masterpiece portfolio. Game Features: A Colorful Quest: Dive into a beautifully crafted, low-poly world where every platform is a step towards your dream. From the serene to the surreal, explore diverse landscapes brimming with life and color. Collectibles Galore: Sharpen your skills and eye for detail by finding hidden platforms and secret caches filled with cameras and SD cards. Your dedication to exploration and collection directly influences your journey's length and the rewards you reap. Thrilling Gameplay Variations: Transition seamlessly from platformer to arcade action as you mount motocross bikes and pilot helicopters, adding exhilarating twists to your photographic expedition. Challenge and Reward: With no checkpoints, 'Mr. Photographer' offers a true test of skill and perseverance. Each attempt is a fresh start, compelling you to refine your strategies and master the game's intricacies. Speedrun or Marathon: Whether you're a speed demon aiming to finish in 1.5 minutes or a completionist targeting the perfect score in a 45-minute epic, your approach defines your experience. Optimize your route or scour every corner for the ultimate collection. Embark on Your Photographic Adventure: 'Mr. Photographer' isn't just a game; it's a journey of growth, creativity, and determination. Your goal is simple yet profound: navigate the trials of an internship to emerge as an established photographer, capturing beauty, adventure, and the moments in between. Are you ready to frame your destiny and snap your way to success? Join us in 'Mr. Photographer,' where every jump is a flash, every collectible a step closer to your dreams, and every playthrough a unique story. Your adventure starts now. Will you capture it?
row.short_description: Low Poly Stylized Platformer Game.

row.name: Arkheim - Realms at War
row.detailed_description: Team up in a Realm of 15 for a ten week long strategic battle across the rediscovered flying Islands of Arkheim to conquer the Eternal Light! In this free to play team based strategy MMO each game round feels different and gives you a new chance to band together and go for victory. You will start each round on a level playing field, competing with other player Realms for resources, territory and ascension. Your village will support the war efforts of your Realm with resources and a multitude of troops as well as valuable Warlord equipment gained from the vast dungeons. The real battle, however, is fought on the strategic real time map on each island, where your armies clash in epic battles. Here you do not only build up your own Realm, but also raid Orbs, conquer towers and fight wars against others to dominate the island. With each Moon Phase, the most successful Realms can conquer Ascension Gates and move to a higher island, where more competition, but also more valuable resources essential for the final battle during the epic endgame phase await. In this last all out war, you reawaken all your fallen soldiers to send them against the vile demons holding the Eternal Anvils, all the wile your enemies move to destroy you forever. Key features of Arkheim - Realms at War: Engage your realm in massive warfare: Unite in a realm with players from all over the world. Fight for territorial conquest and valuable, arcane orbs. Choose your race and build a thriving city: Play as ruthless Elves or inventive Dwarves and turn your settlement into a flourishing city. Command mighty armies and defeat your enemies: Command legendary Warlords, each with a unique set of abilities, and send multiple armies into epic PVP battles. Ascend and conquer the New World: Harvest the power of the three moons and ascend with your Realm into Eternal Light. Play this new fantasy MMO in true cross-platform: The depth of a PC game, with the accessibility of an app.
row.short_description: Experience a new take on the competitive 4x genre with Arkheim - Realms at War: Team based strategy in a free to play MMO fantasy world, played in game rounds of 10 weeks each!

row.name: TukTuk
row.detailed_description: TukTuk is a 2D side-scroller which focuses on precise and unique platforming, and also on fighting. Having a steep learning curve, a fast-paced action-packed experience is established which gets more intense as your skill progresses. TukTuk is designed primarily for experienced players, but non experienced players are taken by the hand through the struggles of TukTuk 's search for her mother. ALL BECAUSE OF A ROCK... TukTuk and her mother travel through space in different spaceships. Suddenly, a meteor hits the spaceship of TukTuk 's mother, and she has to do an emergency landing. TukTuk makes it her mission to find her mother. Is mom okay? And what trouble will TukTuk get into on this unknown planet? That’s your job to find out... YOU ARE THE ARTIST The game is designed to be creative on the platforming sections and there are different tools to do platforming. Especially after the first playthrough, the challenges and how the player chooses to tackle them become more open and offer the possibility to fly through the levels as you like. Every area is unique (if it's not a filler) and created so that the experience is always fresh and entertaining. Also, the camera embraces a very unique playstyle which has to be experienced in order to understand it. DO AS YOU PLEASE Besides the platforming, you will face enemies throughout your quest. The upgrading system will let you choose whether you want to focus on fighting, platforming or both and will let you decide on how you want to play the game. When you feel stuck, there is always the possibility to go back to other levels and farm Lua, the in-game currency. THE SKY IS THE LIMIT We made sure there is a reason to come back to this game. When you are into difficult platforming, the late game will be just right for you. You can almost endlessly improve the stats of your character, but your skill is also always able to improve. This game is made for speedruns. It is a whole new experience when you try to go as fast as you can and the camera emphasizes this fast motion as well.
row.short_description: Fight vicious monsters and other unknown threats on a floral and foreign planet as TukTuk. Utilize your imagination on diverse, precise and intense platforming and skill your character based on your preferences on your epic mission to rescue TukTuk's Mother.
row.notes: There is fighting and a tiny bit of blood .

row.name: Wayward Harbor
row.detailed_description: Wayward harbor is a short first-person horror experience (about 15 min) that takes place in a creepy dark fishing harbor. The player will need to find their way out of the harbor by exploring the environment, searching for key items, while avoiding the monster that is roaming the harbor. Due to the unique abilities of the monster, it will only be visible in the mirror, that the player is holding. This short horror experience was developed by 3rd year students at Howest - Digital Arts & Entertainment: Daniil Shashenkov, Vitaly Tarnover, Christopher Null, Lars Korden and Martijn Dhondt Music composed by Gonçalo Oliveira, a student from the Royal Conservatoire Antwerp: Survive in a thrilling horror experience by using a handheld mirror . You can't trust your naked eyes! The unique mirror mechanic is a new, fresh take on the stealth genre, will you able to get out of the harbor alive? Explore a dark fishing harbor and find your way out by solving obstacles on your way to the boat.
row.short_description: Short first-person horror experience with a unique mirror mechanic. Escape from an invisible monster that can be only seen in the reflection.
row.reviews: “Changing the player’s perspective even a little makes the whole experience something new and fun. And for that, Wayward Harbor is an incredible game.” Dread XP “Only being able to see the monsters via a mirror is a great touch and it makes for some heart-stopping moments as you try and make yur way to the safety of the sea. Highly recommended.” Alpha Beta Gamer
row.notes: This game contains horror themes and minor gore.

row.name: Captain CigArrr
row.detailed_description: Captain CigArrr is a third-person game where the player has to focus on completing objectives and killing enemies on different maps. Every time the player completes a map a shop opens where the player can buy one out of three passives using gold that they collected from killing enemies or collecting treasure around the map. When the objective of the map is completed the player gets points towards their total score based on their performance on the map. Then the next round starts. The game is set in a sea with various islands where the player can sail around. On the sea, there are various adversaries that the player can battle and kill. The player can also embark on these islands to collect gold or do tasks for their objective. When the player dies, their total score is shown and is possibly put on the online leader board if it is high enough.
row.short_description: Captain CigArrr is a third-person naval combat game where the player has to focus on completing objectives and killing enemies on different maps.

row.name: LEZ
row.detailed_description: It's time to feel the rhythm through notes and hit them with rhythm! LEZ is a rhythm game in the style of osu!mania with 6 keys. It's an indie game made by only one person in July 2020 with the goal to make a creative rhythm game with an unique design. A streamer mode for content creators (and also youtubers), we really care about them :D A lot of songs by professional and well know artists. Integration with Logitech G Hub to feel the music through the RGB Do you feel the beatmaps very hard or very easy? There's mods that you can use to increase/decrease the difficulty

row.name: Kurukshetra: Ascension
row.detailed_description: Welcome to the vibrant world of 'Kurukshetra: Ascension' a captivating strategy card game inspired by the Mahabharata and Ramayana, developed by Studio Sirah. Immerse yourself in intense battles and lore by donning the avatars of legendary heroes of the past, now reborn in Kalyug, the Age of Darkness. EXPERIENCE A WORLD INSPIRED BY INDIAN EPICS Use powerful melee, ranged units, and a litany of spells, weapons, and effects to unleash chaos on the battlefield. With an ever-expanding roster of heroes wielding unique abilities and over two hundred playable cards, varied playstyles and creative deck building is encouraged. Make or break the meta as uniquely themed seasons bring brand new cards and balance updates every two months. ASCEND MOUNT MERU IN A CHALLENGING ROGUE-LITE Explore a deeply rooted universe in our PVE story campaign with unique factions, creatures, and forces that transcend time and borders. Relive epic events from aeons ago, while tactically utilizing your cards to outwit Demons, Warriors and Cosmic Beasts. Climb the mythical Mount Meru, explore realms and make choices that weave through and influence a rich tapestry of Indian mythology, all with beautifully illustrated cards depicting these iconic characters and powerful abilities. DOMINATE THE RANKS AND STRATEGIZE WITH NIGHT MODE Test your competitive mettle and climb the leaderboard by pitching yourself in battle against other warriors. Master Melee and Ranged Rows. Seize Free Kills opportunities to maximise your presence on the battlefield. Kurukshetra: Ascension's PvP also draws inspiration from the wars of old, where nightfall provides players with the unique opportunity to strategize under the cover of darkness and change the rhythm of turn-based combat. Our unique mechanic has both players engage simultaneously after a set number of rounds. So, you and your opponent must not only counter each other's moves but also exploit the advantage of newly introduced cards specifically designed for the 'night' phase. The cards add buffs to fortify strategies, bring new units to the board and amplify the fun! EARLY ACCESS AND THE FUTURE We're an indie Indian studio with big ambitions. We want to bring Indian content to games and to a global audience in rich, unique ways. Kurukshetra: Ascension is the beginning of that journey. While the game is still in Early Access, we have already released multiple updates with new realms as chapters to the primary Ascension campaign. We have also released two seasonal content updates - Tribes Of Kishkindha and Echoes of the Beast, with more content on the way. We would love your feedback on the current version as we work to make it even better!
row.short_description: Test your skills in an all-new strategic card battler. Master swift positioning with melee and ranged rows. Plan your path to victory in the dead of night. Explore a deeply rooted universe in a rogue-lite story campaign. Collect, build, command your army, and emerge victorious.

row.name: Bad Credit
row.detailed_description: Bad Credit is a period-piece, neo-western visual novel set in the city of Tucson, Arizona in 2016. Featuring over 100 characters, the player will interact with a nightmarish range of hateful worldviews and morally bankrupt business opportunities to survive Tucson and pay back their loanshark. As political turmoils in the U.S.A. bubble to the surface, the player will make important choices that affect themselves, other characters, and the world around them. As a role-play choose-your-own-adventure, Bad Credit centers around the player's first-person interactions with some of the most hideously deranged people imaginable. The player must struggle to keep their finances in the black over a 12 month period by making astute investments in the truly sickening schemes of the darkest of minds. Over the year, you will encounter a varied array of viewpoints on the current affairs that affected mid-2010s society. You can choose a political position. Become a red-faced socialist. A milquetoast liberal. A rotten fascist. Perhaps you don't want to choose a position. Perhaps you would like to be positioned wherever that bag is. It's all up to you. Bad Credit, above all else, is characterized by its characters. Build your relationships and tear them down where you see fit. Find out their deepest, darkest secrets. Treat them like sidewalk trash. Make them your charity cases. The choice is yours. Will you resist the unease of the information age? Or will you milk it for all it's got?
row.short_description: Let's take it back to 2016. Donald Trump just went on Jimmy Fallon. The new Ghostbusters is still in theaters. You're working as a two-bit financier in the morally and financially bankrupt city of Tucson, Arizona. Take your own path and brave the new world in this neo-western visual novel.
row.notes: Bad Credit includes coarse language. There are no direct depictions of sex or explicit drug use in Bad Credit, though themes of sex work, sexual abuse, and drug abuse are implied through dialogue.

row.name: Nigelopia Mini Mix
row.detailed_description: Nigelopia Mini Mix is a retro-styled 2D platform action game that takes place on the island of Nigelopia, where the rules of life don't apply and the people are wild, crazy and fun! This game here’s got a very rich amount of lore and dialogue that takes some presentational influence from Japanese anime! A cool original sountrack, too! You can play through a 10 level campaign as any of 4 quirky Nigelopian friends, all with unique dialogue and some unique abilities. Finish ‘em all, and the game will be 100 percent clear! The game was patched after launch to address many crashes and improve it as well, but the core remains the same!
row.short_description: Dash, shoot, bash and zoom across Dark Paradise Nigelopia in this hidden gem of a passion project with multiple playable characters, chock full of unique dialogue, awesome music and colorful visuals!
row.notes: Game contains some material that may be considered sensitive, such as suggestive references and dialogue that could offend. Player discretion advised.

row.name: Moonrakers: Luminor
row.detailed_description: Moonrakers Luminor is a fully-cooperative game mode for the board game Moonrakers. You must own a copy of the Moonrakers tabletop game to play. Luminor gives players an entirely new way to play Moonrakers. You and up to 5 players are tasked with tracking down and defeating a Utopian Alliance General. You and your squadron must work your way across a procedurally generated map by attempting multi-tiered narrative driven contracts. Along your way, you'll gain credits, purchase ship parts, hire crew, and eventually face off with a UA General. Can you survive long enough to thwart the efforts of the Utopian Alliance?
row.short_description: A fully-cooperative game mode for the board game Moonrakers. Introducing a co-op game mode for 1-5 players where you'll adventure across a procedurally generated map, attempt multi-tiered narrative-driven contracts, build a ship, and face off against a Utopian Alliance General.
